status: All substantive improvements are planned hypotheses or engineering requirements; no trading-system phase run.

parent_paths.starting_point: Load files into a dataframe for each analysis.
parent_paths.existing_path: Immutable sources, reference decoders, bounded columnar reads and partition manifests.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Repeated experiments can still rescan identical raw partitions or materialize unnecessary columns.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a content-addressed partition index with field/schema/identity/time bounds and a one-pass shared measurement materializer. Register exact sufficient summaries and correction-aware checkpoints so later trials read the smallest valid view; retain the literal reader as the oracle.
parent_paths.comparison: Literal per-trial reads versus projected/chunked/shared views on identical records and downstream outputs; vary chunking and cold/warm cache.
parent_paths.metric: Bytes read, CPU/RAM/storage, restart work and exact event/measurement parity; an engineering upgrade need not create alpha.
parent_paths.fixtures: Interrupted materialization; changed enum/schema; same source under two paths; narrow projection accidentally omits a correction field.
parent_paths.decision_use: Cheaper complete-family research through V08, enabling more useful comparisons within the same budget without duplicating raw data.

parent_paths.starting_point: Identify instruments using display symbols and a few multipliers.
parent_paths.existing_path: PIT identity, expiry/exercise/settlement and operation-specific registry.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Repeated handwritten price/payoff/unit conversions can disagree across options, mappings and account code.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compile validated instrument definitions into reusable payoff, price-domain, tick-rounding, currency and sensitivity-conversion kernels. Attach dimension checks and assumption sets to each conversion path; dispatch to an explicit unsupported path for nonstandard deliverables.
parent_paths.comparison: Hand-coded reference fixtures versus compiled kernels and independent inverse/round-trip paths; compare maintenance and lookup cost.
parent_paths.metric: Zero unexplained payoff/unit differences; unsupported cases detected; lookup latency and definition-change impact radius.
parent_paths.fixtures: Adjusted deliverable; multiplier change; underlying future differs from option root; reciprocal mapping versus conditional inverse.
parent_paths.decision_use: Consistent O/P/X calculations with less duplicated special-case code and clearer data eligibility.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use fixed local-time strings for sessions and resets.
parent_paths.existing_path: Versioned exchange/firm calendars, DST and independent boundary timers.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Many overlapping anchors can independently recompute boundaries or disagree on interval ownership.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compile calendar versions into a shared interval/event graph for formation, publication, reset, holiday and required cutoff. Derive named-session intersections and timer events once, with stable IDs and reusable queries for all anchors.
parent_paths.comparison: String/rule reference versus compiled interval graph across every registered clock, including overlapping/global sessions.
parent_paths.metric: Boundary agreement, timer latency, query cost and number of contradictory/duplicated resets.
parent_paths.fixtures: DST fold; cross-midnight anchor; half-day inside a weekly range; updated required cutoff; no market tick at reset.
parent_paths.decision_use: All C/L/R formation clocks and P boundaries use the same tested calendar events while preserving source-specific definitions.

parent_paths.starting_point: Recompute the whole feature stack at each decision tick.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal multi-rate scheduler, immutable version cuts and late-result expiry.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Even a correct scheduler can spend most of its budget recomputing unaffected producers or deliver useful forecasts too late.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use dependency-driven dirty propagation and incremental state: classify changed raw fields, recompute only affected ports, coalesce superseded optional requests and prioritize producers by registered deadline/decision use. Benchmark a cost-aware schedule with measured runtime costs; integrity lanes remain unconditional.
parent_paths.comparison: Full recompute reference versus incremental/deadline schedules on identical admitted observations and declared decision clocks.
parent_paths.metric: Completed useful forecasts by deadline, p95/p99 lag, CPU/RAM and decision parity; report any policy change caused by scheduling.
parent_paths.fixtures: An OI revision changes exposure but not raw trade CVD; optional source outage; expensive surface fit; late result cannot restart its horizon.
parent_paths.decision_use: Make broad simultaneous information practical without requiring every specialist on every tick.

parent_paths.starting_point: Treat each row as a fresh trade or quote and deduplicate by timestamp/price.
parent_paths.existing_path: Provider-specific action/side/flags, identity and correction lineage.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Every downstream measurement may separately implement correction, overlap and retraction logic.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Emit a canonical transaction-delta stream with explicit insert/revise/cancel operations, original-event ownership and affected field deltas. Share correction reducers across volume, premium, profile and flow views; historical decision views remain immutable.
parent_paths.comparison: Independent raw replay versus shared delta reducers under insert/cancel/revise/reordered-delivery scenarios.
parent_paths.metric: Mass/notional/state reconciliation; correction work and code duplication; no unintended cross-source double count.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two legitimate identical prints; duplicate acquisition; correction changes side and size; correction arrives before original; partially matched standalone/embedded tapes.
parent_paths.decision_use: Upgrade every event-derived measurement by giving it a consistent, efficient correction algebra.

parent_paths.starting_point: Drop a bad file or stop the entire strategy on a quality flag.
parent_paths.existing_path: Raw/semantic checks, field masks, liveness and dependent-expert isolation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A broad family-level mask can either discard too much usable information or understate which derived outputs were damaged.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compile field-to-output quality dependencies and affected time intervals. Produce a minimal invalidation set plus explicit uncertainty for partially affected aggregates; add a preceding-data liveness/change detector calibrated for each source cadence, below hard semantic rules.
parent_paths.comparison: Global/family gating versus field-level propagation on planted and reviewed source faults; compare false halts and escaped corruption.
parent_paths.metric: Corrupt-output escape rate, false-blocked coverage, time to localization and restored independent opportunities.
parent_paths.fixtures: Trade-history gap with recovered book; one expiry missing; healthy unchanged quote; schema corruption limited to one field.
parent_paths.decision_use: Preserve useful independent experts and direct repair effort to the actual limiting data defect.

parent_paths.starting_point: Join sources to the nearest timestamp and carry values forward.
parent_paths.existing_path: Backward availability joins, sparse coverage tensor and purpose-specific eligibility.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Repeated full joins are expensive, and one generic joined table hides different effective information ages.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Maintain incremental interval joins and a compact per-decision version vector. Materialize separate valuation, signing, forecasting and execution views only from eligible intervals; cache common-cohort membership independently of outcome data.
parent_paths.comparison: Reference backward joins versus incremental views; common-grid and source-event cuts under identical availability rules.
parent_paths.metric: Exact eligible-row/age agreement, join CPU/RAM and retained valid coverage by operation.
parent_paths.fixtures: Late correction closes an eligibility interval; sparse daily report; future-nearest match; many contracts share one underlying update.
parent_paths.decision_use: Faster, more transparent full-universe integration for O/X/C/L without weakening causal joins.

parent_paths.starting_point: Back-adjust a continuous futures series and use it for every price calculation.
parent_paths.existing_path: Actual-contract fills, causal roll/adjustment versions and explicit level translation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Return forecasts and absolute-price objects need different histories; restarting everything at a roll can waste useful state.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Maintain paired native-price and roll-neutral return views with a versioned bridge. Transfer only state whose invariants permit transfer; carry scale/return histories while re-anchoring price-bound objects through an uncertainty-tagged bridge or resetting them.
parent_paths.comparison: Full reset, explicit bridge and native-only references on matched roll/corporate-action periods.
parent_paths.metric: Return/price conservation, warmup loss, bridge error versus zone width and economic sensitivity near rolls.
parent_paths.fixtures: Roll spread changes intraday; stale bridge; split/dividend; old-contract profile mapped into new contract; indicator valid only in return units.
parent_paths.decision_use: Keep useful long history without manufacturing executable prices or false roll signals.

parent_paths.starting_point: Aggregate time bars separately for each indicator.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal atomic time/event/volume bars with true OHLC and finalization.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Repeated aggregation can be costly and can subtly change extremes when different consumers partition the same tape.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build mergeable ordered summaries for volume, price-volume moments and cumulative-flow increments/extrema. Derive multiple clocks from shared event blocks while preserving whole-event threshold overshoot and correction dependencies; summarize only quantities with a proved composition rule.
parent_paths.comparison: Literal event traversal versus ordered-block summaries across time/volume/event clocks and chunk boundaries.
parent_paths.metric: Exact OHLC/volume/CVD-extrema parity, throughput, memory and shared-state reuse.
parent_paths.fixtures: One large trade crosses a volume threshold; two blocks have same final CVD but different extrema; correction touches an earlier block; empty interval.
parent_paths.decision_use: Support richer multiscale measurements economically, with a single reference arithmetic path.

parent_paths.starting_point: Keep chart levels in mutable lists and delete them after failure.
parent_paths.existing_path: Immutable market-object revisions, visits, provenance and lifecycle states.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Geometry, observations, forecast views and action aliases can still be entangled, causing duplicate evidence or lost history.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Separate an immutable object/geometry graph, an append-only observation-event graph and derived forecast/action views. Maintain explicit equivalence, parent, split/merge and shared-idea edges; query historical state by cut without replaying all unrelated objects.
parent_paths.comparison: Mutable/reference reconstruction versus graph projections and incremental indexes on the same event history.
parent_paths.metric: Historical-view agreement, duplicate-action rate, lineage completeness and object-query/restart cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: POC and VWAP coincide; node split/merge; object renamed after loss; later geometry correction; expired object needed for labels.
parent_paths.decision_use: All generators gain reusable lifecycle/lineage machinery; L18/P04 can distinguish shared evidence from fresh opportunities.

parent_paths.starting_point: Save feature tables and trained models under descriptive filenames.
parent_paths.existing_path: Content-addressed artifacts, fold/target versions and OOF lineage.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A small upstream definition change can trigger either unnecessary complete rebuilds or dangerous stale reuse.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a dependency-addressed artifact DAG with exact fit/inference closures and column-level transformation ownership. Recompute affected descendants only; keep reusable fold-independent measurements separate from fold-fitted transforms and include executable code/config hashes.
parent_paths.comparison: Clean rebuild versus incremental rebuild after controlled data, definition, target, fold and calibrator changes.
parent_paths.metric: Stale-cache escape rate, identical final artifacts, recompute hours/storage saved and explainable invalidation paths.
parent_paths.fixtures: Scaler changes; same model name with new transform; target horizon changes; late report revision; calibration fitted on a new cohort.
parent_paths.decision_use: Make the full experiment program reproducible and affordable without sharing fitted state across prohibited folds.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use separate historical scripts and a later live connector.
parent_paths.existing_path: Common event contracts, receipt telemetry and historical/live parity.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Equivalent formulas can still diverge because arrival scheduling, reconnect and batching differ.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Create a portable arrival-trace replay format containing source deliveries, timers, computation completions and order-state messages. Drive reference and optimized adapters from the same trace; use seeded fault schedules and minimal divergent-prefix extraction for diagnosis.
parent_paths.comparison: Native historical replay, captured-arrival replay and adapter projections under identical event/timer traces.
parent_paths.metric: Decision/state parity, first divergence, lag distribution and recoverability; actual live evidence remains a later dependency.
parent_paths.fixtures: Reconnect duplicates; batch boundary changes; delayed source; clock adjustment; interrupted computation; timer fires without a trade.
parent_paths.decision_use: Upgrade parity testing from isolated formula checks to reproducible whole-runtime behavior.

parent_paths.starting_point: Label only taken trades or chart-selected successful reactions.
parent_paths.existing_path: All-candidate labels, frozen targets, censoring and simulation provenance.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A correct label table may still overweight dense opportunities or obscure exactly which population an improvement concerns.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a population-indexed label service with clock samples, source episodes, object births, contacts and policy trajectories as separate sampling frames. Record inclusion probabilities where defined by the sampling design, otherwise explicit unknown/unsupported weighting; preserve shared endpoint/report IDs and target transformations; generate explicit risk sets for each forecast.
parent_paths.comparison: Taken-trade, all-contact and full decision-population diagnostics against the declared target population; never promote selected-only performance.
parent_paths.metric: Coverage, label/reference agreement, effective episodes/dates and population-sensitive score/economic differences.
parent_paths.fixtures: One day with thousands of nodes; repeated prefixes share one endpoint; missing horizon; no-touch versus censor; changed candidate density.
parent_paths.decision_use: Every upgrade is judged on the opportunity population it would actually face, with proper source and phase ownership.

parent_paths.starting_point: Random train/test split or one chronological split.
parent_paths.existing_path: Nested walk-forward folds, maturity-aware purge and OOF dependencies.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Handwritten fold logic may miss a learned transform or over-purge harmless historical lookbacks, reducing support.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compile a temporal information graph for every fitted artifact and label span. Generate OOF schedules and machine-readable exclusion proofs from that graph; compare safe maximal-use folds with a conservative reference without changing evaluation dates.
parent_paths.comparison: Reference conservative folds versus compiled dependency/maturity folds; planted indirect leakage through scalers, encoders, gates and calibrators.
parent_paths.metric: Leakage detection, eligible training support, OOF coverage, compute reuse and unchanged outer-test ownership.
parent_paths.fixtures: Long OI endpoint; overlapping object life; innocent past lookback; joint encoder fit on future dates; outer result reused for feature selection.
parent_paths.decision_use: Increase usable evidence and reduce manual leakage errors across the entire multi-stage system.

parent_paths.starting_point: Try many indicators and report the winner.
parent_paths.existing_path: Trial registry, nested selection, useful-effect thresholds and search budgets.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A flat list of trials does not express the original idea's successive upgrades or the cost of abandoning weak branches.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use an experiment-family tree: original construction, faithful/corrected version, representation upgrade, model upgrade and integration trial. Preregister staged screening and allowed interactions; track all attempts, code/data changes and negative outcomes under the same family budget.
parent_paths.comparison: Flat equal-budget sweeps versus staged family screening on planted/null and simulated known-effect problems, then actual research accounting.
parent_paths.metric: False discovery/selection behavior under declared assumptions, useful discoveries per compute, unexamined scope and decision reproducibility.
parent_paths.fixtures: Renamed failed trial; adjacent-window search; optional branch rejection; multiple correlated metrics; an untested family silently disappears.
parent_paths.decision_use: Prioritize the whole program without equating complexity, trial count or a selected score with progress.

parent_paths.starting_point: Accept a high hit rate, attractive Sharpe or one profitable period.
parent_paths.existing_path: Predictive, economic, account and frozen-future evidence gates with inconclusive/no-go outcomes.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A binary pass/fail hides whether failure comes from data, signal quality, decision use, costs, constraints or insufficient precision.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Produce an evidence frontier by component and complete policy: predictive increment, calibration/support, usable opportunity rate, net after execution, account survival, resource cost and uncertainty. Attribute the objective gap with paired reruns and preregister useful tradeoffs rather than maximizing one metric.
parent_paths.comparison: Simple/full policies and each upgrade stage on the same eligible dates and budget; fixed-endpoint or valid sequential future inference.
parent_paths.metric: Best-supported Pareto alternatives, objective gap, uncertainty, risk overshoot and remaining evidence required; no perfection claim.
parent_paths.fixtures: Predictive gain but worse fills; fewer losses but too little opportunity; flat-day exclusion; positive point estimate with wide interval; future period incomplete.
parent_paths.decision_use: Make a concrete research/deployment decision and identify the next worthwhile upgrade when the current system is inadequate.

parent_paths.starting_point: Retrain whenever an indicator or P&L changes.
parent_paths.existing_path: Matured-label drift, calibration monitoring and controlled adaptation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Hundreds of correlated alarms can cause excessive refits or obscure a shared upstream failure.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use hierarchical monitoring from source quality to feature state, target calibration and policy outcomes. Aggregate related alerts by lineage/episode, distinguish source faults from market shifts, and compare residual CUSUM/run-length detectors with simple scheduled review under a registered false-alarm/delay budget.
parent_paths.comparison: No adaptation, fixed reviews and registered adaptive policies on planted drift, stable nulls and chronological replay.
parent_paths.metric: False-alert clusters, detection delay, unnecessary refits, recovery time and full adaptive-policy net/risk.
parent_paths.fixtures: One source fault triggers many experts; rare regime; delayed labels; abrupt versus gradual drift; market shift during missing data.
parent_paths.decision_use: Spend adaptation budget where new evidence warrants it; hard source/risk failures retain independent immediate handling.

parent_paths.starting_point: Compare a few historical and live indicator values.
parent_paths.existing_path: Prefix/restart parity and historical/live calculation contracts.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A final-table difference can be difficult to localize across many asynchronous producers.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add deterministic trace comparison with version-vector checkpoints, first-divergence bisection and dependency-local replay. Check numeric tolerance at outputs and decision sensitivity near thresholds; preserve separate bitwise-reference and permitted numeric-variation reports.
parent_paths.comparison: Whole-run compare versus localized trace diagnostics after deliberately planted timing, numeric and state faults.
parent_paths.metric: Time to causal localization, reproducibility, false parity passes and action changes within numerical tolerance.
parent_paths.fixtures: Floating sum changes rank near tie; expired forecast reused; checkpoint omits unfinished bar; timer/order race; same values with different lineage.
parent_paths.decision_use: Make broad optimizations and deployments diagnosable without weakening semantic or action-level parity.

parent_paths.starting_point: Explain performance using feature importance or selected winning charts.
parent_paths.existing_path: Layered failure attribution and controlled ablations with common cohorts.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Ablation loss conflates unique information, substitution by correlated inputs, model refitting and candidate-population changes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a structured diagnostic matrix: frozen scorer/generator, refitted drop-one, small prespecified interaction tests, representation-versus-capacity comparison and candidate/population controls. Add plausible perturbations and precisely scoped oracle diagnostics, never performance evidence. Certify an upper bound only with an exact scoped optimum or a valid bounding argument; a heuristic oracle is labelled approximate.
parent_paths.comparison: Each diagnostic estimates its stated quantity; compare conclusions across paired dates and preserve incompatible/intervention limits.
parent_paths.metric: Failure ownership, uncertainty of marginal/joint contribution, reproducible attribution and practical upgrade targets.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two redundant features each look unnecessary; interaction-only signal; deleting a generator changes opportunities; attention map misread as causality.
parent_paths.decision_use: Choose whether to improve measurement, add information, change the learner, change selection or remove a branch.

parent_paths.starting_point: Run the largest feature/model grid that fits the machine.
parent_paths.existing_path: Bounded pilots, caching, trial budgets and measured resource envelopes.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Trials may spend too much on low-value duplicate work while valuable families remain unexamined.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Schedule a registered broad-coverage pilot for every eligible family, then allocate expansion by measured support, uncertainty, plausible useful effect and marginal compute cost. Use resumable DAG jobs, shared features and paired scenario seeds; retain explicit rejected/inconclusive/dependency records for every branch.
parent_paths.comparison: Uniform expansion versus staged resource allocation with identical total budget and immutable evaluation sets.
parent_paths.metric: Completed scope coverage, useful evidence per CPU/GPU-hour, peak RAM/storage, wasted duplicate work and reproducible resumption.
parent_paths.fixtures: One expensive model consumes all budget; failed worker; stale cache; rare family needs more days rather than compute; negative pilot closes a branch with evidence.
parent_paths.decision_use: Complete the full authorized research scope efficiently; resource limits can produce explicit inconclusive outcomes, never silent omissions or fabricated success.

parent_paths.starting_point: Choose one Context signal or count agreeing indicators.
parent_paths.existing_path: Target-specific distributions, regularized mixtures and feature-diverse experts.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Several nominally different experts may repeat the same evidence, while a useful small residual signal is overwhelmed by a flexible gate.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add hierarchical stacking by measurement lineage, with within-family and between-family shrinkage, and a residual-correction challenger to a strong simple forecast. Train every gate/correction on chronological out-of-fold predictions; preserve valid distribution support and compare conditional versus global weights.
parent_paths.comparison: Best single, uniform/static blend, existing flat gate, hierarchical stack and regularized residual correction on identical targets and eligible cuts.
parent_paths.metric: Proper loss, calibration, residual diversity, weight stability, incremental constrained net and inference cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Duplicated expert; common input outage; one useful weak expert; new missing pattern; all experts share bias.
parent_paths.decision_use: Obtain useful complementary information without treating correlated variants as independent votes.

parent_paths.starting_point: Convert a volatility number into expected movement.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate variance and joint path mixtures with diverse physical/implied specialists.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A stack may overweight many variants of one estimator and leave inconsistent horizon or tail behavior.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Group primitive forecasts by information/estimand lineage and fit coherent horizon distributions within each valid target family. Compare pooled variance curves plus a separately learned conditional path law against direct path ensembles; share state representations only where target meaning is preserved.
parent_paths.comparison: Single multiscale baseline, uniform blend, flat target-specific stack and hierarchy with explicit horizon/path consistency.
parent_paths.metric: Proper target loss by horizon, tail coverage, first-passage calibration where supported, downstream location/value improvement and cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Many near-identical lags; discontinuity at session boundary; correct RV with wrong return tail; shrinking remaining horizon.
parent_paths.decision_use: A richer ensemble supplies the specific variance, excursion or ordering information its consumers need; no unsupported conversion between them.

parent_paths.starting_point: Interpret fitted probabilities or quantiles literally.
parent_paths.existing_path: Chronological calibration, conditional diagnostics and uncertainty with coherence checks.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Sparse local cells can overfit, while aggregate calibration conceals selection and horizon failures.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare hierarchical shrinkage of conditional calibration parameters across asset/session/coverage/horizon with pooled calibration. Fit coherent target families jointly when feasible and evaluate calibration after the entire projection, gating and selection chain, including best-action versus flat margins.
parent_paths.comparison: Identity, pooled logistic/temperature, isotonic and hierarchical conditional calibration using identical chronological fitting closures.
parent_paths.metric: Proper loss, reliability by supported group, interval coverage, selective risk, effective date support and decision stability.
parent_paths.fixtures: Rare coverage cell; conditional reversal hidden by overall reliability; calibration projection changes rank; outer-test reuse.
parent_paths.decision_use: Supply calibrated uncertainty at the actual decision point, retaining pooled fallbacks when local evidence is insufficient.

parent_paths.starting_point: Reach depends on distance divided by volatility.
parent_paths.existing_path: Competing first-contact hazards and independently validated path-model alternatives.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Marginal reach estimates can miss topology, co-contact, changing travel speed and uncertainty about arrival conditions.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a common landmark event model over frozen candidate regions, with disjoint first-contact/co-contact/gap/no-contact outcomes, arrival time and arrival-state distribution. Compare a sparse discrete hazard model with a shared path-scenario law that also generates these labels; include state-dependent activity clocks without changing wall-clock cutoffs.
parent_paths.comparison: Distance baseline, independent hazards, joint landmark hazards and validated common path scenarios under identical frozen objects.
parent_paths.metric: Joint log/proper score, contact/time calibration, gap/co-contact error, pre-touch value and runtime.
parent_paths.fixtures: Overlapping bands; gap jumps nearer band; removed optional candidate; slow approach followed by burst; censored boundary.
parent_paths.decision_use: Give G05/G07 a coherent distribution of where, when and in what observable state price may arrive.

parent_paths.starting_point: Score a level by bounce or target-hit rate.
parent_paths.existing_path: Distinct pre-touch and post-touch ordered departure, continuation and runner models.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A binary success label loses rebound-then-failure, traversal and duration that alter exit value.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a compact multi-state landmark model for contact, initial departure, retrace, renewed departure, traversal and expiration; define barriers and states before outcomes. Compare structured transition hazards against direct joint outcome/time heads and simple empirical episode tables; pre-touch forecasts integrate possible arrival states.
parent_paths.comparison: Existing hit/runner heads versus structured episode model and joint direct heads, at matched cuts and information budgets.
parent_paths.metric: Ordered path proper loss, duration/return calibration, stop/exit decision value and uncertainty by independent episode/date.
parent_paths.fixtures: Fast bounce then failure; delayed runner; re-entry into band; simultaneous barriers; no resolved outcome by cutoff.
parent_paths.decision_use: Separate temporary reaction from sustainable opportunity and provide distributions usable by full-position management.

parent_paths.starting_point: Multiply win probability by reward and subtract loss/cost.
parent_paths.existing_path: Joint fill, path, cost, occupied duration and terminal-state action value.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Independent action estimates waste shared information and can exaggerate uncertainty in one difference while understating common model error.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Evaluate all feasible complete policies on coupled, admissible outcome scenarios and common random numbers. Compare direct action-value fits with a regularized model of paired value differences relative to a simple policy; propagate common fill/price/latency errors jointly and preserve the cash reward contract.
parent_paths.comparison: Empirical outcome table, existing distributional value, coupled scenario evaluation and paired residual-value model.
parent_paths.metric: Paired value error, policy regret on supported simulation assumptions, net/tail calibration, ranking stability and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two actions share every outcome until one stop event; incompatible fill scenarios; double-counted continuation; profitable but long occupancy.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve enter/route/exit comparisons while making common uncertainty and simulator dependence explicit.

parent_paths.starting_point: Take the nearest good level or wait for confirmation.
parent_paths.existing_path: Common-boundary finite-horizon policies with occupancy and information transitions.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Waiting rules rarely separate the information gained from the price, time and opportunity lost while obtaining it.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add bounded two-decision lookahead with explicit observation-event transitions. Estimate the incremental value of the next observable stage versus price deterioration, nonarrival and opportunity consumption; compare to a myopic policy and fixed waits before expanding depth. Include a finite-horizon value-of-information decomposition as a diagnostic.
parent_paths.comparison: Positive-value now, fixed deeper/confirmation wait, one-step and bounded two-step policies with identical candidate availability and reward accounting.
parent_paths.metric: Full-day constrained net, waiting regret, missed/expired opportunities, occupancy, transition calibration and planning cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: No confirmation arrives; better level invalidates; new opportunity appears while occupied; additional signal changes nothing; boundary intervenes.
parent_paths.decision_use: Choose when waiting improves the complete day policy instead of treating stronger confirmation as automatically beneficial.

parent_paths.starting_point: Rank levels by distance, size or confluence count.
parent_paths.existing_path: Complete action sets, calibrated values and pairwise/listwise/set alternatives.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Equivalent actions and correlated objects can inflate competition; value differences near the selected maximum remain poorly calibrated.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Canonicalize actions with identical execution/terminal-policy meaning, preserve their evidence provenance, then compare calibrated pairwise value differences and set-aware selection. Add conservative dominance pruning only when the declared outcome/continuation model establishes it; benchmark against complete enumeration and keep a no-pruning reference.
parent_paths.comparison: Nearest/confluence, pointwise value, paired difference and set policy; full enumeration versus proven-local pruning.
parent_paths.metric: Selected-versus-flat calibration, net/regret, candidate coverage, action stability under duplicates and decision latency.
parent_paths.fixtures: Duplicate geometry with distinct evidence; action differs only in expiry; unseen set size; apparent pointwise dominance fails after occupancy.
parent_paths.decision_use: Select among complete feasible alternatives with less duplicated evidence and measured computational savings.

parent_paths.starting_point: Trade when enough indicators agree.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate critical validity and later uncertainty/support gates with risk-coverage evaluation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Large forecast disagreement need not change the best action, while small forecast error can reverse a close decision.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare action-stability and conditional regret gates under joint uncertainty scenarios with forecast-spread thresholds. Evaluate reduced-use, wait and flat choices separately; use supported reliability estimates and preserve unconditional integrity/risk rules. Calibrate the resulting selected policy rather than only the ungated predictor.
parent_paths.comparison: Always-use-valid, fixed spread/support thresholds and joint action-instability/regret rules under the same opportunity set.
parent_paths.metric: Net-versus-coverage frontier, tail risk, abstention opportunity cost, decision disagreement and date support.
parent_paths.fixtures: Uncertain forecasts imply same action; precise forecasts have near-tied values; unsupported missing pattern; false confidence from correlated experts.
parent_paths.decision_use: Abstain for decision-relevant uncertainty while retaining useful opportunities whose action is robust within tested assumptions.

parent_paths.starting_point: Refit the full system whenever performance falls.
parent_paths.existing_path: Per-expert versioned adaptation, mature-label monitoring and rollback.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: One schedule can over-update stable measurements while missing deterioration in calibration or action selection.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Separate measurement-state updates, forecast parameters, calibrators, mixture weights and policy thresholds into independently versioned change layers. Compare bounded layer-specific update policies and champion/challenger shadow evaluation under a fixed intervention/false-alert budget; evaluate the complete adaptation policy prequentially.
parent_paths.comparison: Frozen, uniform scheduled refit, layer-specific schedule and registered drift response with identical data maturity and total budget.
parent_paths.metric: Recovery delay, unnecessary changes, calibration/net after costs, artifact compatibility and rollback time.
parent_paths.fixtures: Calibration drift with stable ranking; upstream source fault; many correlated alerts; changed model needs new calibration; performance dip from chance.
parent_paths.decision_use: Change the smallest evidenced layer and retire unsupported experts without discretionary rescue of a future test.

parent_paths.starting_point: Convert a signal directly into an order.
parent_paths.existing_path: Complete one-mini state/action policy with risk-approved intents and causal event decisions.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Reference research and optimized runtime can interpret the same action or order transition differently.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compile registered action templates and pre/postconditions into a shared policy transition protocol, with a literal reference reducer and optimized executor. Explicitly encode pending entry, protective orders, action expiry, terminal time and reward ownership; enumerate small reachable state graphs for semantic checks.
parent_paths.comparison: Hand-authored reference transitions versus compiled templates and optimized execution on identical event traces.
parent_paths.metric: State/action parity, unreachable illegal states, duplicate intent detection, transition latency and reproducible recovery.
parent_paths.fixtures: Candidate changes while entry pending; exit and stop race; clock cutoff without price event; flat state with live entry order.
parent_paths.decision_use: Keep increasingly rich selection and management policies within the same complete executable one-mini contract.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use a fixed RR or a source stop and target.
parent_paths.existing_path: Structural stops, valid tick rounding, path distributions and budget feasibility.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Optimizing stop, target and expiry separately can choose a bracket that is jointly dominated or unfunded at actual entry.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Construct a joint feasible frontier over source-faithful stop variants, destination, expiry and route using the same coupled path/cost scenarios. Prune only verified dominated complete plans; compare robust lower-value/tail constraints with expected-value selection. Keep structural invalidation distinct from adjustable buffers.
parent_paths.comparison: Fixed/source bracket, structural nearest target, full registered grid and conservative frontier selection at identical entry cuts.
parent_paths.metric: Net and tail loss, budget-feasible opportunity coverage, sensitivity to fill price, frontier regret and computation.
parent_paths.fixtures: Tick rounding crosses headroom; target reached after expiry; mapping uncertainty changes stop; high-value plan consumes all remaining day.
parent_paths.decision_use: Choose complete feasible brackets with a transparent tradeoff among loss, destination, time and execution uncertainty.

parent_paths.starting_point: Move a stop to entry or trail each new swing.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate full-position exit, stop, target and hold policies with incremental value.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Frequent marginal amendments may add latency/race exposure and overreact to noisy small value changes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Estimate the incremental full-exit/hold/amend value relative to the current committed policy on paired scenarios. Compare shrinkage and hysteresis/minimum-value thresholds for optional amendments, accounting for cancel/replace delay and loss of old protection; emergency risk actions bypass discretionary thresholds.
parent_paths.comparison: Fixed bracket, simple trail, existing stopping model and incremental-value policy with/without amendment hysteresis.
parent_paths.metric: Constrained net, giveback/tail risk, amendment count, protection gaps and incremental value calibration.
parent_paths.fixtures: Tiny oscillating benefit; large thesis failure; old stop fills during replace; target extension loses a timely exit.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve management only when its expected benefit survives amendment costs and uncertainty for the entire single position.

parent_paths.starting_point: Retry a level a fixed number of times.
parent_paths.existing_path: Idea lineage, fresh-evidence rules and cumulative idea/day budgets.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A new timestamp or return to the same band may repeat the original evidence rather than renew opportunity.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a causal evidence-novelty and replenishment state for each idea, separating new flow/structure/source changes from reused observations. Compare repeat quality conditional on visit history with pooled first-entry quality, using partial pooling for sparse later visits and the same cumulative budget.
parent_paths.comparison: No retry, fixed cooldown/count, existing repeat model and novelty-conditioned repeat value.
parent_paths.metric: Net by visit and idea, cumulative loss/tails, false novelty, missed renewed opportunities and independent idea support.
parent_paths.fixtures: Band reissued with new ID; same prints reused; new valid defense after loss; profitable prior trade but no new evidence.
parent_paths.decision_use: Permit re-entry only when fresh information adds value under unchanged one-unit and cumulative-risk constraints.

parent_paths.starting_point: Assume a touch fills the order.
parent_paths.existing_path: Venue/information clocks, marketable reference fills and passive uncertainty scenarios.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Independent optimistic/pessimistic assignments can create impossible comparisons among policies sharing one market path.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build coupled admissible fill scenarios with explicit latent queue/priority assumptions and common venue paths. Report partially identified economic ranges across the registered scenario set, preserving policy occupancy and order races; add telemetry-calibrated probabilities only when eligible observations exist.
parent_paths.comparison: Marketable baseline, independent passive bounds and coupled feasible-scenario bounds; later telemetry-calibrated model when supported.
parent_paths.metric: Width of economic uncertainty, fill/markout calibration on supported cohorts, ordering consistency and policy robustness.
parent_paths.fixtures: Competing orders cannot both receive the same scarce execution; cancel race; queue reset; insufficient depth; shared path with different occupancy.
parent_paths.decision_use: Distinguish promising policies robust to available fill uncertainty from ones requiring better execution evidence.

parent_paths.starting_point: Subtract a fixed spread and commission.
parent_paths.existing_path: Itemized shortfall, latency, adverse selection and route-conditioned cost models.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Mean costs obscure joint tails of delay, fill and adverse movement precisely when a signal looks strongest.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit a compact joint execution outcome law for fill/no-fill, elapsed time, shortfall and subsequent markout conditional on route and observable state. Compare state-conditioned quantile/competing-risk models with conservative tables; separate controllable route effects from unsupported counterfactual claims.
parent_paths.comparison: Fixed conservative cost, spread/pace table, existing cost regression and joint outcome model on matched eligible data.
parent_paths.metric: Joint/quantile loss, tail coverage, net after route choice, robustness to latency stress and additional data value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Fast market widens spread and delay together; passive fill selects adverse paths; crossed venue; fee version changes.
parent_paths.decision_use: Price the full execution tradeoff and favor routes whose advantage survives observed support and cost uncertainty.

parent_paths.starting_point: Send, cancel and retry orders based on acknowledgments.
parent_paths.existing_path: Durable idempotent state machine, broker reconciliation and unknown states.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Rare interleavings and restart boundaries can evade a few happy-path replay cases.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Specify a bounded protocol model with invariants and exhaustively enumerate short event interleavings, then replay generated traces through the reference reducer and adapter. Test durable intent/outbox checkpoints, duplicate acknowledgments and reconciliation; external exactly-once behavior is conditional on verified broker capabilities.
parent_paths.comparison: Handwritten scenarios versus model-generated trace corpus and adapter/reference replay.
parent_paths.metric: Invariant failures, reachable unknown-state recovery, duplicate external intent risk and time to reconcile.
parent_paths.fixtures: Crash between persist/send; late fill after cancel; duplicated/reordered ack; non-atomic OCO; broker snapshot older than fill.
parent_paths.decision_use: Strengthen deterministic order safety and recovery as the number of allowed policy actions grows.

parent_paths.starting_point: Stop trading after realized loss reaches a threshold.
parent_paths.existing_path: Liquidation-based headroom, remaining adverse reserve and atomic pending-exposure accounting.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Blind summation wastes headroom, while incompatible favorable offsets or missed races underreserve it.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Enumerate feasible near-term order/fill/cancel states and calculate incremental loss reserve on each state using a shared scenario tree. Compare the maximum valid reserve with a conservative additive reference; offsets require an enforceable relationship, and market gaps retain explicit stress uncertainty.
parent_paths.comparison: Additive reference versus feasible-state reserve engine on identical positions, fees, order semantics and stress envelopes.
parent_paths.metric: Zero reserve omissions in enumerated cases, feasible opportunity retention, compute latency and breach outcomes under stress.
parent_paths.fixtures: Entry and protective order race; cancel unconfirmed; already marked loss; fee accrued once; apparently offsetting orders both increase exposure.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use scarce one-mini risk headroom more precisely without weakening the independent daily/firm veto.

parent_paths.starting_point: Treat a funded account as a fixed profit target and loss limit.
parent_paths.existing_path: Versioned product/account state machines and exact rule scenarios.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Separate handwritten rule calculations can diverge across research, monitoring and cash reports.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Represent product rules as typed balance functions, calendar predicates and lifecycle transitions with an evaluation trace. Compile the same definition into reference account replay and runtime checks; include effective-version and unknown-term handling. Any commercial comparison uses verified current terms at its actual decision time.
parent_paths.comparison: Hand-calculated paths and existing engine versus compiled rule definitions with independent arithmetic fixtures.
parent_paths.metric: Rule parity, explanation coverage, update impact, lifecycle/cash reconciliation and unsupported-term detection.
parent_paths.fixtures: Trailing floor locks; pending payout affects headroom; rule changes by purchase date; holiday boundary; failed account retained.
parent_paths.decision_use: Make product feasibility and breach reasons reproducible without letting a learned strategy reinterpret account rules.

parent_paths.starting_point: Flatten a fixed number of minutes before close.
parent_paths.existing_path: Independent boundary timers, actual remaining horizons and conservative cancel/flatten buffers.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single fixed buffer ignores route-specific tail latency and the time needed to discover and reconcile unknown orders.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a deadline-budget controller that allocates time to cancel, reconcile, flatten and verify. Compare fixed conservative buffers with measured conditional latency quantiles and bounded retry plans; choose latest permitted entry from the complete boundary-truncated plan. Missing telemetry uses the registered conservative fallback.
parent_paths.comparison: Fixed buffer versus conditional deadline budget under identical required cutoff and fault scenarios.
parent_paths.metric: Flat/no-live-order verification time, missed cutoff frequency in simulation, final-period opportunity value and safety margin.
parent_paths.fixtures: No ticks near cutoff; cancel timeout; reconnect; halt; early close; high latency correlated with volatility.
parent_paths.decision_use: Retain eligible late opportunities only when the full exit/reconciliation plan fits the mandatory boundary budget.

parent_paths.starting_point: Judge the target from winning trades or displayed funded P&L.
parent_paths.existing_path: All eligible-day trading net, separate cash ledgers, fees, failed accounts and payout states.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A mean result alone hides whether the gap to the objective comes from signal value, risk feasibility, inactivity or cash restrictions.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add an auditable objective-feasibility decomposition and scenario frontier: opportunity count, budget-fit rate, selected trade value, zero-trade days, tail breaches, business costs and payout timing. Preserve common chronological account paths and uncertain product inputs; report the $2,000 goal on both accounting bases until specified.
parent_paths.comparison: Simple daily mean versus complete trading/account/cash path reports with paired assumptions and uncertainty.
parent_paths.metric: Mean net per eligible day, distribution of cash timing, drawdown/breach frequency, objective shortfall decomposition and unresolved inputs.
parent_paths.fixtures: Many profitable days but no payout; failed attempts incur fees; long no-trade periods; fee timing differs from P&L; exceptional day dominates mean.
parent_paths.decision_use: Show what would have to improve for the one-account objective to be supported, without treating the target as a reason to chase losses.

parent_paths.starting_point: Prefer the market that moves more points.
parent_paths.existing_path: Matched-date one-mini NQ/ES comparisons under identical constraints and frozen selection.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Raw net averages can hide which market loses opportunities because one mini cannot fit the same USD budget or execution conditions.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build risk-budget-compatible opportunity curves by instrument, decomposing information quality, structural stop feasibility, route costs, frequency and occupancy. Compare fixed NQ/ES and development-selected policies using paired dates and common uncertainty; any intraday selector remains a separately evaluated flat-confirmed policy.
parent_paths.comparison: Always NQ, always ES, existing development choice and feasibility-aware selection with the same scope and trial budget.
parent_paths.metric: Net/day and paired uncertainty, budget-fit coverage, tail loss, fees/latency sensitivity and objective feasibility.
parent_paths.fixtures: NQ stronger forecast but no affordable structural stop; ES lower costs but fewer useful moves; unequal data dates; selection after seeing outer test.
parent_paths.decision_use: Choose the actual one-mini instrument on constrained economic opportunity, preserving NQ preference under the registered noninferiority rule.

parent_paths.starting_point: Call an approach fast or slow.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal approach episodes with speed, acceleration, signed effort, progress and pauses.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Absolute speed and volume mix normal session activity with unusual pressure at a particular distance from the level.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Construct approach trajectories in distance-to-frozen-band, wall time and covered activity, with residual speed/effort relative to comparable session/distance states. Compare compact trajectory summaries and a shared event kernel; expose stop-start structure and direction changes rather than only an average.
parent_paths.comparison: Fast/slow rules, raw summaries, exposure-normalized residual summaries and compact trajectory model.
parent_paths.metric: Approach-state reproducibility, conditional path loss, entry timing value and computation.
parent_paths.fixtures: Long pause then burst; high normal opening activity; moving band; sparse tape; crossing from wrong side.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve estimates of arrival quality and immediate-versus-wait decisions at every eligible location type.

parent_paths.starting_point: High volume with little price movement means absorption.
parent_paths.existing_path: Observable stall prefixes separated from later displacement and book evidence.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Large effort can be ordinary for the state, and the same stall can precede reversal or continuation.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Estimate expected progress conditional on side-specific executed effort, spread, depth, activity and distance, then model the progress residual and its persistence. Keep print-only and book-supported channels separate; compare a joint effort/progress surface with the simple ratio and a transition hazard after the stall.
parent_paths.comparison: Source ratio, normalized residual surface, additive transition model and bounded local sequence challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Conditional event/path loss, stall-versus-continuation calibration, net timing value and support.
parent_paths.fixtures: Huge volume with normal low progress; missing book; unknown side; sustained hold eventually breaks; zero progress denominator.
parent_paths.decision_use: Identify unusual resistance to pressure and forecast its next branch without asserting hidden participant intent.

parent_paths.starting_point: Declining push volume signals exhaustion.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal push segmentation, effort/pace decay and quiet-progress distinction.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Changing push duration, distance and trade-size mix can manufacture a decline in aggregate volume.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Model push effort and progress jointly after exposure adjustment for duration, distance and cohort composition. Compare robust sequential slopes with partially pooled push-to-push transition models; preserve incomplete pushes and uncertainty in segmentation rather than waiting for the final best turning point.
parent_paths.comparison: Raw declining digits, normalized trend, pooled transition hazard and optional compact sequence model.
parent_paths.metric: Exhaustion/continuation proper loss, lead time, false signals from segmentation and incremental value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Shorter push with same intensity; quiet quote-led continuation; changed cohort mix; unfinished last push.
parent_paths.decision_use: Distinguish weakening pressure from a merely shorter observation interval and price progress requiring less effort.

parent_paths.starting_point: An extreme burst marks a climax.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal burst detection and separate continuation/rejection outcomes.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A fixed tail cutoff ignores local intensity and cannot distinguish concentrated stopping effort from broad accelerating participation.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use conditional burst surprise by covered exposure, price concentration, cohort breadth and contemporaneous progress; retain a simple robust seasonal quantile baseline. Model post-burst competing continuation/stall/reversal transitions at detection and later prefixes; marked-intensity complexity must beat the compact features.
parent_paths.comparison: Raw quantile burst, state-normalized surprise, additive hazard and optional marked-process model.
parent_paths.metric: Tail-event detection stability, branch/time calibration, incremental entry/exit net and false alarms.
parent_paths.fixtures: Ordinary opening burst; distributed broad advance; one print dominates; late report; burst still in progress.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use the shape and context of extreme activity rather than assigning every large print the same reversal meaning.

parent_paths.starting_point: Displayed size returns, so the level is defended.
parent_paths.existing_path: Execution-adjusted net recovery, recovery delay and survival at the best price.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: One recovery statistic hides repeated depletion cycles, diminishing resilience and uncertainty from batched book events.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a touch-local depletion/recovery episode ledger with pressure exposure, recovery-time distribution, retained displayed fraction and cycle-to-cycle decay. Compare deterministic recovery summaries with a state-transition hazard for price loss/reclaim, propagating feasible net-recovery bounds.
parent_paths.comparison: Hold rule, print-only, book-only, joint episode summaries and transition model.
parent_paths.metric: Price-survival/reclaim proper loss, recovery-time calibration, bound sensitivity and economic increment.
parent_paths.fixtures: Book batch conceals adds/cancels; zero displayed size; unchanged quote price; repeated recovery weakens; execution timing uncertain.
parent_paths.decision_use: Measure how resilience evolves under actual pressure while retaining the limits of MBP-1 observation.

parent_paths.starting_point: Read depth support or pulling from a displayed ladder.
parent_paths.existing_path: Full-depth mechanism explicitly blocked where absent, plus distinct BBO turnover proxies.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single top-book snapshot loses the sequence of resilience as price visits successive levels.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Create a coverage-aware successive-best-price resilience map from observed visits, executions and recovery, with unobserved deeper levels explicitly absent. If suitable depth arrives, compare its incremental spatial support/cancellation information against the same top-book opportunity cohort; do not backfill hidden depth.
parent_paths.comparison: BBO snapshot, successive-best episode map and separately eligible full-depth challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Measured-state fidelity, conditional adverse movement loss, incremental data value and coverage.
parent_paths.fixtures: Price skips unobserved levels; repeated level visit; top size changes without depth; new depth feed has different dates.
parent_paths.decision_use: Extract more supported structure from current observations and define exactly what additional depth would need to improve.

parent_paths.starting_point: A green candle with negative delta is a reversal clue.
parent_paths.existing_path: Distinct closed-bar and developing footprint effort-result disagreement.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Two sign bits discard where opposing effort occurred, the path through the candle and whether the result was unusual.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Represent side-specific effort over causal body/wick/current-range coordinates and time within formation; add progress residuals and unknown-side mass. Compare continuous interactions and low-rank spatial-temporal summaries with raw signs, preserving separately trained developing and completed-bar cuts.
parent_paths.comparison: Sign rule, scalar interaction, structured footprint summaries and small tensor model.
parent_paths.metric: Target proper loss, spatial contribution, timing delay cost, net increment and data support.
parent_paths.fixtures: Final wick differs from current geometry; same totals with opposite event order; near-zero delta; body definition changes.
parent_paths.decision_use: Turn disagreement into a graded, spatial and temporal description of pressure versus achieved movement.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use a fixed diagonal imbalance ratio and count stacked rows.
parent_paths.existing_path: Exact diagonal/same-price variants, smoothing, minimum support and causal stack lifecycle.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A large ratio from sparse cells can outweigh a broad supported stack, and one maximum hides partial repair.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare posterior/shrunken side contrast with an exposure-weighted contiguous-support statistic; retain width, integrated contrast, uncertainty, gaps and repair fraction. Track the stack as a frozen causal object with forward revisions, then test its survival/action role separately.
parent_paths.comparison: Source ratio/length grid, shrunken cell contrasts, integrated stack support and local model.
parent_paths.metric: False stack rate on sparse cells, geometry stability, defense/failure calibration and net location increment.
parent_paths.fixtures: Zero denominator; one contract creates huge ratio; gapped stack; partial repair; tick-grid change.
parent_paths.decision_use: Produce stable defense regions and confidence appropriate to the amount and continuity of observed flow.

parent_paths.starting_point: A POC flip from low to high indicates control changed.
parent_paths.existing_path: Developing mode identity, dominance margin, mass centroid and successive-bar migration.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Argmax flips can reflect a near tie, while meaningful mass redistribution can occur without changing the maximum.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Track the distribution of newly added volume on a frozen grid, mode confidence set, normalized mass shifts and transport relative to the prior normalized profile. Decompose old fixed mass versus new additions; compare incremental functional summaries with the existing POC/centroid and tensor approaches.
parent_paths.comparison: POC sign/flip count, mass moments, transport/new-mass summaries and optional structured learner.
parent_paths.metric: Grid/tie stability, early branch calibration, action value, latency and sensitivity to total exposure.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two equal modes alternate; profile grows without relocating old trades; truncation/overflow; same final profile with different order.
parent_paths.decision_use: Detect meaningful developing auction change while separating unstable maxima from supported new mass.

parent_paths.starting_point: Read control from CVD above a median or from one divergence.
parent_paths.existing_path: All distinct multiscale price/CVD, cohort and cross-market cases with causal confirmation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Rolling CVD trends can be driven by expected activity and correlated horizons; divergence labels omit whether flow or price is surprising.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use joint expected-flow/expected-progress residuals and distributed lag responses at matched causal cuts. Preserve each source divergence as a comparator, add a sparse multiscale interaction model, and distinguish flow leading price, price resisting flow and contemporaneous disagreement.
parent_paths.comparison: Source cases, raw multiscale regression, residual lag features and pooled conditional model.
parent_paths.metric: Per-case path loss, lead-time calibration, unknown-side sensitivity, net increment and redundancy.
parent_paths.fixtures: Reset creates false divergence; noisy small cohort; same event reused at many horizons; asynchronous source market.
parent_paths.decision_use: Unify comparison of control mechanisms without erasing their distinct directional and temporal meanings.

parent_paths.starting_point: Trade a break, retest or failed auction as one setup.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate ordered branches, prior-balance POC versus broader value, and unfinished outcomes.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Hard completed-pattern recognition misses useful partial prefixes and confuses expected duration with failed confirmation.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a semi-Markov branch model with explicit A/B objects, reference type, elapsed stage time and no-retest transitions. Compare source finite-state rules with partially pooled hazards that estimate each next branch and remaining travel; forecast at every permitted prefix.
parent_paths.comparison: Source completed patterns, branch tables, duration-aware hazards and compact sequence model.
parent_paths.metric: Branch/time proper loss, prefix incremental value, no-retest coverage and exact source-case fidelity.
parent_paths.fixtures: B-POC never reached; value edge reached instead; stalled unfinished traverse; return to A without entry authorization.
parent_paths.decision_use: Price the choice to enter, wait or cancel during the full balance-transition process.

parent_paths.starting_point: A failed squeeze means fade, or a refill means squeeze again.
parent_paths.existing_path: Plain squeeze, failed fade and renewed original-direction branches with separate origin IDs.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single failure flag misses how much of the initial move survived and whether new effort replenished the original thesis.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Represent squeeze/failure/refill as a signed progress-and-effort trajectory with surviving displacement, reclaimed origin fraction, new versus reused flow and elapsed stage time. Compare shared transition models with branch-specific residuals against the source finite-state paths.
parent_paths.comparison: Source rules, branch frequencies, continuous stage summaries and duration-aware shared/branch model.
parent_paths.metric: Branch calibration, sparse-branch uncertainty, prefix value and cumulative idea loss.
parent_paths.fixtures: Complete versus partial failure; refill at a distinct pocket; quiet renewal; no renewed squeeze; catalyst persists after local failure.
parent_paths.decision_use: Distinguish reversal from renewed continuation using measurable retained structure and fresh evidence.

parent_paths.starting_point: Fade a quiet failed push without waiting for own-side aggression.
parent_paths.existing_path: Observed slowing/failure separated from missing tape and own-flow confirmation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Quietness may be normal inactivity, degraded coverage or efficient progress with low trading effort.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Model the joint occurrence of reduced opposing intensity and reduced progress relative to covered state-dependent expectations; include quote-led progress and observed recovery when available. Compare failure-only action with direct C/L and later confirmation using the same boundary and executable prices.
parent_paths.comparison: Raw quiet rule, normalized failure features and joint hazard, each with act-now/wait policy comparisons.
parent_paths.metric: Failure/continuation calibration, detection delay, coverage robustness and complete policy net.
parent_paths.fixtures: Tape outage; normally quiet interval; low-volume steady trend; quote retreat without prints; valid quiet rejection.
parent_paths.decision_use: Retain a supported passive-reversion branch without treating absence of displayed activity as evidence by itself.

parent_paths.starting_point: Require a fixed absorption/reward/refresh sequence before entry.
parent_paths.existing_path: Every causal stage and alternative source tick/update interpretation has its own action comparison.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A conjunction can discard valuable early entries and demand a later stage that adds little information at a worse price.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Estimate incremental information and action value after each named prefix, allowing skipped/alternative transitions in a compact stage graph. Compare additive evidence accumulation and duration-aware hazards with strict conjunctions; explicitly price confirmation delay and optional reward-area retest.
parent_paths.comparison: Each source threshold path, additive stages, flexible transition graph and bounded lookahead adapter.
parent_paths.metric: Conditional value of each additional stage, calibration, missed moves, actual-entry net and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Recovery in updates differs from price ticks; lift-off without refresh; late confirmation exhausts runway; repeated stage adds no new evidence.
parent_paths.decision_use: Retain the useful parts of the sequence and determine which observed stages deserve waiting for.

parent_paths.starting_point: An aggression origin that was rewarded is protected structure.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal markout maturity, confirmed protection, survival and role reversal.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single successful reaction overstates durability and conflates a strong market trend with location-specific defense.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Estimate protection strength from excess markout relative to matched context, new defense evidence and cumulative pressure, using shrinkage and age-aware survival. Compare price-only structure, raw rewarded effort and residual protection; preserve origin geometry and confirmation delays.
parent_paths.comparison: Source protection, swing-only trail, raw markout survival and context-residual survival/value.
parent_paths.metric: Useful-lifetime calibration, incremental trail/exit value, decay stability and independent origin support.
parent_paths.fixtures: Trend rewards every print; delayed markout not yet mature; strong first reaction followed by depletion; role reversal.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use protected structure according to tested persistence and added information, rather than a permanent label after one favorable move.

parent_paths.starting_point: Repeated tiny reactions inside a wick identify a precise level.
parent_paths.existing_path: Frozen neighboring nodes, causal interaction, overshoot/reclaim and current footprint evidence.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Sparse exact-price reactions encourage overprecise levels and retrospective selection of a visually attractive wick point.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Model reaction intensity across a local price band with uncertainty and neighboring-region competition; shrink repeated responses by common episode and compare band-based versus exact-tick anchors. Include overshoot depth, new pressure and whether the same reaction is counted by several nodes.
parent_paths.comparison: Node-only/flow-only, exact-tick source, uncertainty-band summaries and spatial conditional model.
parent_paths.metric: Out-of-sample location precision, useful reaction/runner calibration, net after spread and effective episode count.
parent_paths.fixtures: One wiggle touches several nodes; final wick unavailable; sparse minor peak; neighboring level explains reaction.
parent_paths.decision_use: Assess whether minor structure earns a tradable precision improvement over a broader known region.

parent_paths.starting_point: Prefer the first or second defended retest.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal visit separation, cumulative testing and hierarchical durability/depletion hazards.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Visit number is a weak proxy when visits differ in pressure, recovery, duration and fresh evidence.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Replace count-only strength with cumulative pressure dose, recovery history, time since last defense and evidence novelty; keep visit count as an explicit comparator. Use recurrent-event transitions with shared object/episode effects and reset only under registered lifecycle rules.
parent_paths.comparison: First/second/count rules, existing repeat hazard and pressure-dose/renewal model.
parent_paths.metric: Visit-conditioned calibration, cumulative idea net/loss, false visit counts and sparse-late-visit uncertainty.
parent_paths.fixtures: Several flickers are one visit; second visit much weaker; refreshed evidence after long pause; object split/reidentified.
parent_paths.decision_use: Distinguish depletion from renewed defense using the history that actually changed the object's state.

parent_paths.starting_point: Enter a completed sweep/block with one fixed midpoint rule.
parent_paths.existing_path: Faithful source timeframe, entry, stop, rejection and failure-through branches.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Bar alignment and discrete candle completion can dominate apparent setup quality and delay execution.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add an event-time sweep/reclaim trajectory using the same frozen source anchors, plus continuous overshoot, reclaim speed and retained displacement. Compare it to each exact candle/timeframe variant with matched information-delay and executable-entry budgets; optimize entry/stop only in their registered joint grid.
parent_paths.comparison: Faithful 2/3/5-minute variants, corrected causal variants, event-time summaries and conditional action model.
parent_paths.metric: Source fidelity, sensitivity to bar phase, prefix path calibration and complete one-mini net/risk.
parent_paths.fixtures: Signal exists under one bar alignment; no retracement fill; confirmation after move; failure-through momentum; stop rounds beyond budget.
parent_paths.decision_use: Test whether continuous causal geometry improves the timing and robustness of the preserved source patterns.

parent_paths.starting_point: Require Response confirmation for every entry and use it for exits too.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate entry filtering, timing refinement and residual management on frozen C/L opportunities.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single ablation can hide whether Response helps information quality, changes entry price or merely rejects hard trades.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a factorial action adapter comparing no Response, filter only, timing only, management only and prespecified combinations on the same initial opportunity ledger. Model paired incremental policy value at each actual prefix and remaining horizon, including skipped trades and occupancy.
parent_paths.comparison: Direct C/L, simple price confirmation, each Response role and bounded combined policies.
parent_paths.metric: Full-day net, role-specific incremental value, selection/population effects, delay cost and complexity.
parent_paths.fixtures: Filter improves hit rate but loses net; exit signal useful without entry signal; delayed entry changes stop feasibility.
parent_paths.decision_use: Assign Response only the roles for which it adds evidence-backed value to the complete policy.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use visual Pine patterns and oscillator crosses as fixed signals.
parent_paths.existing_path: Every preserved source member has faithful computable and corrected causal variants.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Binary pattern names discard continuous geometry, parameter stability and overlap among nearly identical scripts.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: For every registered member-specific family, extract causal continuous distances, run lengths, overlap/repair fractions, pivot age and oscillator divergence magnitude alongside the exact source rule. Export relative positions, band asymmetry and convergence/divergence of supported anchors; downstream anchor selection uses only causal context and fixed comparisons.

Preserve threshold values at leg birth, record split/merge revisions forward, and compare compact tree summaries with one-scale swings under matched delay budgets.

parent_paths.starting_point: Remember a large print or cluster as a permanent trapped level.
