Generate a bounded entry-time/price frontier using X05's conditional transmission and G07 waiting costs; compare immediate versus pullback versus confirmation on the same events.
parent_paths.comparison: No source, local-touch-required, immediate source event and residual-lifetime-aware entry alternatives.
parent_paths.metric: Transmission/time calibration, remaining net value, missed pullbacks, latency sensitivity and one-mini feasibility.
parent_paths.fixtures: Receiver already moved before source receipt; no local touch; source failure during wait; stale event reissued.
parent_paths.decision_use: Originate receiver trades from fresh source information when their remaining opportunity survives timing, execution and risk constraints.

parent_paths.starting_point: Refine a hand-drawn level or predict a best price.
parent_paths.existing_path: Bounded grids/offsets, candidate budgets and no-reach/unresolved labels.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A flexible generator can improve hit rate by widening regions or flooding the candidate set rather than finding better locations.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Factor proposal learning into contact probability, conditional role/outcome and executable utility over a fixed relative-price grid. Compare sparse selected bands with fixed grid/source candidates under matched count, width and decision cuts; use uncertainty-aware offsets and cross-fitted generator/scorer closure to avoid selection leakage.
parent_paths.comparison: Fixed source/grid, KDE, existing utility proposal, factored spatial model and bounded offsets.
parent_paths.metric: Spatial proper loss, count/width-controlled selected net, proposal stability, no-reach calibration and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Generator/scorer train on same held-out labels; far unreachable peak; wide band claims success; offset creates a new unsupported object.
parent_paths.decision_use: Learn where useful opportunities may exist while making the source of improvement and selection cost measurable.

parent_paths.starting_point: Delete a level after a touch or fixed expiry.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate factual lifecycle from forecast useful life, retest/failure and role transitions.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Time and visit count underdescribe cumulative pressure, refresh and gradual role change.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use recurrent-event survival/transition models with pressure dose, fresh evidence, time away and object lineage, sharing strength across compatible families. Compare fixed expiry with value-aware retention/retirement as a full policy, keeping observations after retirement for unbiased diagnostics where available.
parent_paths.comparison: Delete-on-touch/time/count, shrunken hazard, pressure/renewal lifecycle and value-aware retention.
parent_paths.metric: Lifetime/transition calibration, retained opportunity value, stale-candidate cost and lineage stability.
parent_paths.fixtures: Object split/merge; retirement hides later success; refreshed evidence; many tiny visits; unknown coverage interval.
parent_paths.decision_use: Keep or retire locations according to tested remaining usefulness rather than a universal touch-count heuristic.

parent_paths.starting_point: Count confluence and merge overlapping chart lines.
parent_paths.existing_path: Complete candidate sets with provenance groups, distinct identities and set alternatives.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Geometric overlap, common data ancestry and action equivalence are different relations that one merge rule can confuse.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build separate geometry, evidence-lineage and executable-action relation graphs, then derive compact set features and canonical action groups. Compare deterministic relation-aware aggregation with a sparse set/graph learner under equal candidate budgets; preserve an unmerged reference and source-clause trace.
parent_paths.comparison: Independent list, simple overlap merge, typed relation graphs and learned aggregation with controlled inputs.
parent_paths.metric: Duplicate/action invariance, retained source coverage, selected net, set stability and latency.
parent_paths.fixtures: Same line from one raw source counted many times; distinct evidence same action; overlapping bands different expiries; graph order changes.
parent_paths.decision_use: Give selection compact complementary evidence and complete alternatives without losing provenance or inventing extra independent signals.

parent_paths.starting_point: Trade the price of a large print or presumed trapped origin.
parent_paths.existing_path: Causal effort clusters, price-only controls, matured reward and protected-origin states.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Cluster size alone does not identify whether a memory remains useful or whether nearby ordinary price structure explains it.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Generate support-weighted memory regions from M11's sparse field, with novelty, pressure history and context-residual markout/lifetime estimates. Compare exact center, cluster band and neighboring price-structure controls, preserving source fixed filters and causal confirmation of protected status.
parent_paths.comparison: Source print/cluster, price-only origin, raw aggression memory and residual lifetime/role model.
parent_paths.metric: Placebo-adjusted location information, useful lifetime, precision versus width, net and cumulative idea risk.
parent_paths.fixtures: Trend rewards all origins; one cluster dominates; same evidence reused; protected label not yet confirmed; neighboring swing explains reaction.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use meaningful effort-origin memory as a tested location family with graded relevance and explicit alternatives.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use one named time range and its quarters/extensions.
parent_paths.existing_path: All disclosed source clocks, session geometries, inner/outer anchors and unresolved interpretations are preserved.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Independent range scalars hide nested/overlapping relationships and repeated geometry, while arbitrary clock choice can dominate results.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Create a causal range-relation graph with shared/unique formation intervals, nestedness, overlap, relative width, opening position and inter-anchor displacement. Keep every exact source clock as a baseline; compare relation features and boundary-robust variants before C05 learned discovery, with no retrospective best window.
parent_paths.comparison: Each source range, individual geometry, multi-range relation basis and registered clock-phase perturbations.
parent_paths.metric: Exact anchor fidelity, phase stability, incremental path information, candidate redundancy and net contribution.
parent_paths.fixtures: Cross-midnight window; shared endpoints; partial holiday range; inner range outside prior outer range; unfinished formation.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use relationships among the full range family while preserving the specific clocks and definitions that generated the ideas.

parent_paths.starting_point: Label a range as broken, swept or reclaimed.
parent_paths.existing_path: Ordered high/low breach, repeated return, depth, gap contact and source tolerance variants.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A discrete state omits how far, how long and under what pressure a break persists; repeated events can multiply labels without adding evidence.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add duration, excursion, accepted time/volume, effort and return-depth trajectories to the exact event automaton. Compare shrunken transition tables with semi-Markov competing next-event hazards, preserving simultaneous/gap cases and causal state revisions.
parent_paths.comparison: Exact source states, empirical transitions, continuous state summaries and duration-aware hazards.
parent_paths.metric: Next-branch/time proper loss, state fidelity, repeated-event stability and policy value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Brief wick versus sustained acceptance; high then low versus low then high; repeated shallow recross; gap over edge.
parent_paths.decision_use: Forecast the evolving meaning of breaks and reclaims using their observed strength and duration.

parent_paths.starting_point: Apply one Jumbo day type or projection rule.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate wide/internal, compressed/extension, first-leg, return, partial-retrace and no-move experts.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Hard branch subdivision can waste sparse data and hide shared dynamics; one successful endpoint can conceal a poor entry path.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a shared causal path representation with branch-specific residual heads and duration/ordering distributions. Compare independent specialists, pooled model and hierarchical partial pooling; branch applicability uses only observed geometry/prefix, and every source branch retains its own scorecard.
parent_paths.comparison: Source branch rules, pooled simple model, independent heads and shared-plus-branch residual model.
parent_paths.metric: Branch-specific joint path/time loss, rare-branch support, downstream internal/extension value and complexity.
parent_paths.fixtures: Wide range still extends; compressed range fails; partial retrace then runner; overlapping branch attributes; no useful move.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve all Jumbo paths while testing whether specialization adds information beyond a strong shared baseline.

parent_paths.starting_point: Opening outside value implies a drive or reversal.
parent_paths.existing_path: Continuous open location plus explicit overlapping open-drive/test/rejection/auction path attributes.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A completed opening type arrives late and hides uncertainty during the opening sequence.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Represent opening behavior as a landmark prefix with displacement, revisit, tested reference, effort efficiency and elapsed persistence. Forecast each next attribute/transition and remaining path with partial pooling across open locations; compare completed-type usage only at its actual availability.
parent_paths.comparison: Source open tables, location-only baseline, continuous prefix features and duration-aware opening transition model.
parent_paths.metric: Opening attribute/path calibration, early decision value, confirmation delay and rare-type uncertainty.
parent_paths.fixtures: Drive becomes rejection; test reference differs from value edge; auction and drive attributes overlap; opening reference unavailable.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use opening structure as evolving evidence rather than waiting for or assuming a final day-type label.

parent_paths.starting_point: Choose a better fixed clock range by trial and error.
parent_paths.existing_path: Registered clock, activity, volatility and auction stopping rules with nested selection budgets.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Searching many windows can find unstable winners, while a single stopping rule forces different sessions into the same formation pattern.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare a small diverse ensemble of causal range proposals with one selected range, using stability-regularized selection and shared relation features. For adaptive formation, estimate stop/continue utility from prefixes with explicit duration, coverage and downstream candidate costs; benchmark simple activity thresholds before a learned boundary hazard.
parent_paths.comparison: All source clocks, fixed-grid winner, simple activity/auction stops and bounded diverse proposal ensemble.
parent_paths.metric: Nested out-of-sample gain, boundary stability, search-adjusted uncertainty, range/candidate budget and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Tiny timing change flips result; no clear auction transition; stopped range later expands; one day favors many hindsight windows.
parent_paths.decision_use: Discover useful formation schemes without letting clock search or proliferating ranges manufacture apparent improvement.

parent_paths.starting_point: Turn a historical average or SD into an upper/lower zone.
parent_paths.existing_path: Conditional joint excursions, quantiles, ordered touches and observed-prefix remainder targets.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Separate marginals omit dependence and time; one static daily distribution becomes stale after an unusual prefix.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare joint U/D/time/ordering distributions with calibrated marginal baselines and a validated path-law challenger. Add prefix-conditioned residual distributions and common-horizon scenario outputs; compare empirical analog retrieval, distributional regression and compact structured models while preserving all source estimands.
parent_paths.comparison: Source statistics, seasonal empirical, marginal quantiles, joint model and matched-information prefix/path challengers.
parent_paths.metric: Proper joint/quantile loss, tail/ordering/time calibration, band stability and downstream action value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Large move already occurred; both tails possible; no future observations; session boundary truncates; zero future excursion is valid only when observed.
parent_paths.decision_use: Forecast remaining opportunity and path uncertainty rather than assigning win probability to an average range or quantile line.

parent_paths.starting_point: Classify the auction as balance, acceptance, rejection or discovery.
parent_paths.existing_path: Continuous observed acceptance/overlap/expansion axes and causal transition models.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: One regime label conflates participation, spatial acceptance and directional progress, and transitions may have different durations.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Factor auction state into separate occupancy/acceptance, value migration, directional efficiency and participation axes, then model their joint next transitions. Compare interpretable additive interactions with filtered duration models, retaining conflicting/uncertain states rather than forcing one label.
parent_paths.comparison: Source labels, pooled continuous axes, additive transition model and filtered duration-state challenger.
parent_paths.metric: State/transition calibration, persistence timing, contribution of each axis and economic increment.
parent_paths.fixtures: High participation with no progress; low-volume discovery; value shifts without price trend; missing tape resembles balance.
parent_paths.decision_use: Describe and forecast auction behavior through independently measurable dimensions with tested interactions.

parent_paths.starting_point: Track the slope of POC or overlap of value areas.
parent_paths.existing_path: Distribution distance, emerging modes, valley filling and aligned developing profile comparisons.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Describing past movement does not predict where future traded mass or useful regions will form.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add explicit future profile-evolution targets on a grid frozen at the cut, with overflow and future added-mass versus total-profile distributions. Compare persistence/seasonal expected-profile baselines, low-rank mass-increment models and optional spatial-temporal encoders conditioned on flow, auction state and elapsed exposure; forecast mode/VA changes as derived targets.
parent_paths.comparison: POC/overlap rules, transport features only, expected-profile residual baseline and future mass-evolution model.
parent_paths.metric: Proper mass-distribution score, mode/VA transition calibration, incremental path/location net and grid robustness.
parent_paths.fixtures: New mode appears outside grid; total volume unknown; same POC with mass shift; elapsed maturity mismatch; missing future tape.
parent_paths.decision_use: Upgrade profile migration into a testable forecast of auction development, with economic value evaluated separately from shape accuracy.

parent_paths.starting_point: Scale today's room from yesterday's range or ATR.
parent_paths.existing_path: Robust rolling/seasonal distributions and exact range-versus-variance targets.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Fixed lookbacks poorly share information across sparse calendar states and may overreact to one extreme day.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use hierarchical seasonal baselines that pool time-of-day, weekday/event and volatility-state effects with train-only shrinkage. Compare empirical quantile curves, recency weighting and simple additive distribution models; preserve a no-condition/persistence floor and separate opening jump from intraday range.
parent_paths.comparison: Previous/ATR, existing seasonal/EWMA, hierarchically pooled empirical distributions and simple GAM.
parent_paths.metric: Proper range/quantile loss, tail coverage, stability across years and downstream value relative to added cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Rare event day; holiday duration; isolated extreme; changing volatility level; many zeros from unavailable data.
parent_paths.decision_use: Make the simple baseline strong and adaptive enough that richer specialists must demonstrate real incremental information.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use one OHLC-based volatility estimate as future movement.
parent_paths.existing_path: GK measured on compatible intervals and separately mapped to future variance/path targets.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: OHLC estimates at several scales can be redundant or affected differently by opening jumps, noise and short intervals.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Preserve the verified GK formula and add scale/interval diagnostics plus residual information relative to close-return and RV baselines. Compare pooled lag regression with a reliability-conditioned GK contribution in G02, holding forward target and observation set fixed; GK alone does not supply barrier ordering.
parent_paths.comparison: Close/EWMA, lagged GK, multiscale GK residual features and regularized reliability-conditioned forecast.
parent_paths.metric: Reference arithmetic, common-target QLIKE/proper loss, incremental information, scale stability and net downstream use.
parent_paths.fixtures: Opening jump omitted; very short noisy interval; flat prices; invalid OHLC ordering; many redundant scales.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use GK where its measured range information adds forecast value, rather than assuming the estimator is itself a prediction.

parent_paths.starting_point: Add opening jumps to an OHLC volatility number.
parent_paths.existing_path: YZ separates opening return, intraday close return and Rogers–Satchell components.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A combined scalar hides which component changes and whether a session convention makes the opening term meaningful.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Keep verified YZ and expose its component/scale contributions with compatible session-gap metadata. Compare component-wise lag and asymmetric response models with the aggregate estimator, sharing shrinkage with other physical-volatility specialists while retaining target and horizon distinctions.
parent_paths.comparison: Aggregate YZ, GK/RS/close baselines, component-wise linear model and regularized interaction challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Formula/component parity, future variance/tail proper loss, calendar stability and incremental ensemble/economic contribution.
parent_paths.fixtures: Futures short maintenance gap versus cash overnight; roll gap; nontrading day; short sample; one jump dominates.
parent_paths.decision_use: Test whether opening and intraday components forecast different future behavior instead of hiding them in one combined value.

parent_paths.starting_point: Sum squared sampled returns and call it volatility.
parent_paths.existing_path: Multiple sampling grids, noise-robust variants and up/down semivariance.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Sampling choice and correlated estimator error can dominate incremental information; total RV hides signed temporal clustering.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a measurement-error-aware multiscale RV/semivariance panel with quality/noise diagnostics, signed clustering and matched observation windows. Compare a good coarse-grid baseline, fixed multigrid combination and train-fitted reliability weighting; use components in common-horizon forecasts before complex encoders.
parent_paths.comparison: Coarse RV, subsampling/pre-averaging variants, fixed blend, reliability-weighted panel and matched-lag predictor.
parent_paths.metric: Measurement stability, common-target QLIKE/proper loss, tail calibration, data-quality sensitivity and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Bid/ask bounce; stale carry; sparse grid; jump at boundary; opposing signed bursts produce equal total RV.
parent_paths.decision_use: Separate genuine variation information from sampling artifacts and test which multiscale/directional components improve forecasts.

parent_paths.starting_point: Extrapolate one recent volatility number.
parent_paths.existing_path: Daily/weekly/monthly HAR, transforms, jump/semivariance inputs and richer common-target mixtures.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Fixed rectangular lag averages may approximate memory poorly, while flexible alternatives can win through extra inputs or tuning rather than better dynamics.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare HAR, HAR-J/semivariance variants, regularized smooth distributed lags and an explicitly specified ARFIMA-on-log-variance long-memory challenger. Preserve the user's spoken HAR/ARFI upgrade path; ARFIMA is a proposed operational interpretation, not an asserted source formula. Register memory order, stationarity/domain, initialization, retransformation and matched information/tuning budgets; retain every estimator's individual contribution in G02.
parent_paths.comparison: Persistence/EWMA, source HAR variants, smooth lag basis, ARFIMA challenger and compact nonlinear model under separate information/capacity comparisons.
parent_paths.metric: Common-target QLIKE/proper loss, tail/interval calibration, memory stability, inference cost and incremental ensemble/net value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Log-zero handling; mean-log retransformation bias; long-memory fit near boundary; structural break; future lag average.
parent_paths.decision_use: Test how much temporal memory and richer dynamics improve forward volatility, without conflating the estimator collection with the forecasting model.

parent_paths.starting_point: Mark large returns as jumps or volatility bursts.
parent_paths.existing_path: Continuous/discontinuous proxies, local thresholds, event hazards and post-burst decay.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: One jump statistic loses sign, clustering, duration and uncertainty about whether microstructure produced the event.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a probabilistic discontinuity/burst feature panel with signed jump size, clustering, contemporaneous flow/liquidity and decay trajectories, preserving deterministic threshold/BV comparators. Compare additive jump-augmented forecasts with a compact marked-event transition model; quality artifacts remain a separate input class.
parent_paths.comparison: Large-return threshold, RV/BV proxy, jump-augmented HAR and conditional burst/decay model.
parent_paths.metric: Event/tail/time proper loss, decay calibration, noise robustness and incremental path/value contribution.
parent_paths.fixtures: Bid/ask bounce; clustered jumps; opening gap; return after outage; prolonged burst differs from isolated jump.
parent_paths.decision_use: Forecast the consequences and persistence of unusual movement rather than treating all large returns as the same event.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use ATM IV or one skew number as the volatility input.
parent_paths.existing_path: Full supported smile/skew/curvature, total/forward/event variance, variance-gap, surface-change, leverage, 0DTE and cross-IV children.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A rich feature list can be redundant and still miss coherent surface innovations and their changing relation to physical outcomes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add a low-rank functional representation of supported strike/tenor surfaces and innovations after mechanical spot/time movement, retaining observed uncertainty. Compare interpretable factors, residual nonlinear terms and a joint price/surface-shock law; bridge to physical variance/tails using chronological forecasts, with each existing child independently ablated and both primitive C15.SCENARIO and later physical ports kept acyclic.
parent_paths.comparison: ATM-only, all existing engineered child features, regularized functional factors, factor-plus-residual and joint shock challengers.
parent_paths.metric: Own-surface and physical proper loss by target, conditional tails, support/arbitrage diagnostics, child contribution and downstream net.
parent_paths.fixtures: Missing wing; sparse 0DTE; tenor event crossing; same IV different remaining trading time; correlated surface uncertainty; changing variance premium.
parent_paths.decision_use: Upgrade the entire implied-information family through coherent representation and forecast relationships, preserving each distinct source feature and its limits.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use VIX/VX level or curve slope as a stress flag.
parent_paths.existing_path: Separate VIX-option forward/surface/VVIX, daily VX curve, joint stress and native VX-option branches.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Static levels miss whether stress reflects forward level, tail repricing, volatility-of-volatility or a change in cross-market coupling.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a decomposed stress-state trajectory from independently supported forward, term, tail and vol-of-vol innovations, with common uncertainty and event clocks. Compare additive receiver-tail forecasts with low-rank joint dynamics and conditional spillover kernels; native VX options remain independently data-gated and are never replaced by OHLC-derived IV.
parent_paths.comparison: Equity RV only, primitive volatility-complex signals, existing joint stress, decomposed innovations and compact joint dynamics.
parent_paths.metric: Own-source and receiver-tail proper loss, stress lead time, calibration, redundancy and constrained net contribution.
parent_paths.fixtures: Daily VX appears repeated intraday; right wing absent; parity forward uncertain; source stress without receiver move; option-on-VX distinct from VIX option.
parent_paths.decision_use: Determine which parts of the full volatility complex add fresh information and at what horizon.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use a weekday or news-time avoid/trade rule.
parent_paths.existing_path: Known-calendar anticipation, actual observed release/reaction and post-event decay are separate.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Broad event bins pool different phase, surprise availability and overlapping events, obscuring when risk actually changes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit event-family time kernels for anticipation, release response and decay, partially pooling sparse events and preserving exact publication vintages. Model overlapping-event interactions only with support; compare calendar-only, observed reaction and eligible surprise features at their actual cuts, using horizon intersections with event time.
parent_paths.comparison: Source calendar rules, pooled bins, partially pooled event-time kernels and supported interaction/surprise challengers.
parent_paths.metric: Event-tail/time proper loss, uncertainty by independent release, pre/post value and waiting/flatten cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two releases overlap; delayed release; press conference follows statement; consensus vintage absent; horizon straddles event.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use the timing and type of known and observed events to forecast changing opportunity and risk with explicit information availability.

parent_paths.starting_point: Treat CVD direction or tape speed as control.
parent_paths.existing_path: Independent continuation, failed-effort, persistence, participation and cohort-disagreement heads.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Separate scalars can miss nonlinear coupling between expected flow, price response, cohort breadth and book resilience.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use M01–M13 residual pressure/progress and multiscale state to fit a compact joint marked-flow/price transition representation, with separate named output heads. Compare additive/interactions before sequence models, and test raw versus residual, ordinary versus cohort, close versus true OHLC and trade versus quote information independently.
parent_paths.comparison: Source CVD/OFI rules, simple joint features, residual interaction model and compact sequence challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Per-head proper loss, temporal lead/lag calibration, family interaction value, complete net and latency.
parent_paths.fixtures: Large flow is expected; price moves without aggression; cohorts disagree; unknown signs; same final delta different path.
parent_paths.decision_use: Upgrade participation/control prediction through measured interactions while keeping every mechanism and information contribution reviewable.

parent_paths.starting_point: Subtract used range from ADR to estimate remaining fuel.
parent_paths.existing_path: Prefix-conditioned remaining extrema/time distributions truncated at the true boundary.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single room number misses asymmetric path possibilities, conditional expansion and how soon movement can occur.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit a coherent remaining-horizon surface over upward/downward travel, first passage and resolution time, conditioned on current price, realized prefix and state. Compare direct remainder models with a validated conditional full-path law; provide primitive movement/time outputs to G/P, which alone derive executable feasibility frontiers.
parent_paths.comparison: Seasonal remainder, fixed ADR cap, direct conditional quantiles/hazards and coherent remaining-path model.
parent_paths.metric: Horizon/path proper loss, boundary calibration, expansion/quiet-state error and downstream wait/stop/target value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Day exceeds prior range forecast; late fast opportunity; already travelled both sides; hard cutoff shortens horizon; variance high but signed payoff poor.
parent_paths.decision_use: Quantify remaining attainable movement and timing without imposing a spent-volatility ceiling or feeding current action values back into forecasts.

parent_paths.starting_point: Name a day as trending, balanced or high volatility.
parent_paths.existing_path: Continuous interpretable axes, causal filtered states and separate coverage drift.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Regime models may fit retrospective clusters that add no predictive information and can confuse gradual transitions with abrupt changes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare predictive state representations trained on next observable outcomes with descriptive regime fits, using a low-dimensional interpretable axis baseline and optional filtered latent residual state. Preserve posterior uncertainty, duration and drift; fit only chronological prefixes and distinguish representation changes from parameter adaptation.
parent_paths.comparison: No regime, continuous axes, filtered HMM/HSMM/change point and predictive residual-state challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Downstream proper loss/net, state stability, transition delay, support and coverage-artifact sensitivity.
parent_paths.fixtures: Mixed trend/balance evidence; abrupt source change; gradual market drift; rare state; future-smoothed label looks perfect.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use state conditioning only when it improves future decisions, with uncertainty and observable meaning retained.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use a session-to-session hit table or AM/PM pattern.
parent_paths.existing_path: Every source session/body/open/range target and exact ordered check window is retained.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A fixed session label loses how much of its typical activity/path has already occurred and how transitions depend on the prior session.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build duration- and activity-aware transition features on exact source clocks, using causal expected-activity phase rather than future total volume. Compare hierarchical pair-of-session models with pooled temporal kernels, preserving each reference/ordering target and including holiday/DST/overlap state.
parent_paths.comparison: Source time-window tables, shrunken frequencies, exact-clock conditional model and activity-aware hierarchical transition model.
parent_paths.metric: Per-transition path/time calibration, seasonal/clock stability, independent date support and net contribution.
parent_paths.fixtures: AM expansion followed by further expansion; overlap of global sessions; early close; body25 versus open-to-open target; partial current session.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve the full session-transition family through richer observed phase and conditional relationships, without replacing exact source clocks.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use Context only to filter a separately generated entry.
parent_paths.existing_path: Context forecasts can originate complete current-price or conditional-entry opportunities.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single threshold may ignore several feasible ways to express the same forecast and duplicate candidates from other originators.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compile a bounded library of Context-originated opportunity templates with side, trigger/entry, invalidation, destination, horizon and evidence lineage. Compare immediate and conditional templates using calibrated path distributions and shared G/P value, deduplicating equivalent actions while preserving source evidence; no Response prerequisite is introduced.
parent_paths.comparison: No Context origination, source simple rule, calibrated threshold and bounded template/proposal alternatives.
parent_paths.metric: New useful opportunity coverage, duplication invariance, calibration, complete-policy net and one-mini feasibility.
parent_paths.fixtures: Strong Context with no local level; conditional trigger never arrives; two experts propose same action; future best entry unavailable.
parent_paths.decision_use: Let the full Context family create testable trades as well as inform selection, with every proposal passing common execution/risk rules.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use high-low range as a volatility proxy.
parent_paths.existing_path: Verified Parkinson measurement and separate common-horizon forecasts/comparators.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Range-only information can be redundant with GK/YZ or distorted by interval length and missing opening movement.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Expose scale-consistent Parkinson contributions and residual range information relative to close-return/RV baselines, with gap/duration/quality metadata. Compare aggregate lag regression, component residual forecasting and G02 reliability weighting; preserve the diffusion-based estimator as the exact comparator.
parent_paths.comparison: Close/EWMA, Parkinson lags, GK/YZ/RS controls, residual range features and regularized forecast.
parent_paths.metric: Reference arithmetic, common-target proper loss, gap/scale stability, incremental ensemble value and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Unobserved opening jump; one extreme quote not trade high; short interval; constant price; drift-heavy period.
parent_paths.decision_use: Determine whether the range statistic supplies useful distinct forecast information under the actual observation process.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use constant variance or a simple ARCH/GARCH recursion.
parent_paths.existing_path: Constrained low-order models, explicit multi-step horizon aggregation and tail/asymmetry challengers.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Return-only recursions can react slowly to new intraday measurements and fit tails separately from variance dynamics.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare GARCH/asymmetric recursions with a compact realized-measurement-augmented variance model and a residual combination with HAR. Register each equation, positivity/stability/innovation assumptions and chronological initialization; match inputs separately when testing model class versus added RV information, and calibrate predictive tails.
parent_paths.comparison: Constant/EWMA, ARCH/GARCH, registered asymmetric/t innovations, realized-measurement augmentation and HAR residual combination.
parent_paths.metric: Variance and tail proper loss, parameter stability, horizon calibration, computation and incremental ensemble/net value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Near-unit persistence; structural break; heavy tails; measurement unavailable; multi-step covariance assumptions; nonpositive numerical state.
parent_paths.decision_use: Test whether conditional dynamics and fresh realized information improve the complete volatility ensemble beyond simpler memory models.

parent_paths.starting_point: Take one downloaded option chain as the universe.
parent_paths.existing_path: Sparse PIT union, distinct listed/quoted/traded/OI universes and field-specific coverage.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Repeated chain joins are costly, and a single coverage percentage hides structurally different holes that change model support.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Maintain an incremental contract/strike/expiry support tensor with listing lifecycle, observation age, value-source lineage and operation eligibility. Cache only validated shared views; expose support topology and stable common-cohort projections to models, with sparse residual imputation a separately scored option.
parent_paths.comparison: Literal sparse union, fixed intersection and incremental support-aware views; compare imputation only on masked observed targets and eligible downstream cohorts.
parent_paths.metric: Identity/coverage parity, query cost, held-out field error, support robustness and downstream uncertainty.
parent_paths.fixtures: New listing; duplicate near/broad acquisition; disappearing wing; unchanged chain with fresh quotes; expired contract omitted from report.

parent_paths.starting_point: Invert a midpoint into one IV number.
parent_paths.existing_path: Contract-specific price validation, bracketed inversion and bid/ask uncertainty intervals.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Near expiry or low vega, a precise numerical root can represent weakly identified volatility; repeated full inversion can waste compute.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add price-to-IV conditioning diagnostics and interval-aware inversion, switching downstream comparison to price-space when IV is weakly identified. Use bounded warm starts/adaptive solver tolerances tied to option-price and consumer sensitivity error; retain independent literal solvers for European and eligible American styles.
parent_paths.comparison: Mid root, bid/ask interval, condition-aware price/IV representation and optimized versus reference solver.
parent_paths.metric: Price reconstruction, interval/domain fidelity, sensitivity error, failure detection and latency.
parent_paths.fixtures: Intrinsic-only quote; tiny vega; one-sided market; dividend/exercise boundary; negative-rate/carry domain; near-zero time.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve numerical usefulness and speed while making the information content of an IV estimate explicit.

parent_paths.starting_point: Assign every option trade a buy/sell sign from its price.
parent_paths.existing_path: Reliable sign where available, conservative quote/tick rules and calibrated-label dependency.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Hard assignments near quote boundaries hide timing and classification uncertainty, and independent signs understate shared quote error.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Construct sign-evidence likelihoods over admissible preceding quote states and report raw rule decisions, uncertain mass and common quote-error groups. Compare conservative intervals and probabilistic classifiers only on reliable matched-label cohorts; O20 later handles package-level alternatives without feeding its result back into the early sign port.
parent_paths.comparison: Reported/quote/tick/conservative-unknown, timing-aware sign scenarios and eligible calibrated classifier.
parent_paths.metric: Sign calibration by quote age/condition, unknown retention, grouped uncertainty and downstream flow sensitivity.
parent_paths.fixtures: Locked/crossed quote; quote arrives late; inside-spread print; shared stale quote signs many trades; reliable futures label fails to transfer.
parent_paths.decision_use: Preserve usable directional information with uncertainty that reflects the actual classification evidence.

parent_paths.starting_point: Interpolate IV points into a smooth curve.
parent_paths.existing_path: Contract-consistent constrained surfaces, temporal continuity, missing support and price/IV uncertainty.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Smoothness alone can overfit noisy midpoints or create false precision in sparse wings and temporal extrapolation.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit a robust interval-aware price surface with low-rank temporal factors and constrained residuals, comparing static snapshot fits with causal filtered updates. Preserve common parameter/quote uncertainty and distinguish interpolation from forecast/extrapolation; test future quote/price prediction and downstream sensitivity separately.
parent_paths.comparison: Nearest/flat, constrained interpolation, SVI/SSVI or style-consistent price surface, temporal factors and bounded residual challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Held-out price loss relative to spreads, arbitrage/domain diagnostics, uncertainty coverage, temporal stability and economic increment.
parent_paths.fixtures: Missing wing; conflicting quotes; expiry approaches zero; American exercise feature; broad common surface error.
parent_paths.decision_use: Improve the usable shape and dynamics of the surface without mistaking a smooth fitted curve for complete observation.

parent_paths.starting_point: Add Gamma and higher Greeks as separate scalars.
parent_paths.existing_path: Unit-consistent local and surface-aware sensitivities verified against finite differences.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Local derivatives become unstable or inaccurate for finite moves, while computing every derivative at full precision can be expensive.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a consumer-specific response cube from full repricing over registered joint price/volatility/time shocks, with local Greek approximations and measured truncation error. Use adaptive finite differences/automatic derivatives where valid and cache only requested sensitivities; compare sticky conventions as scenarios rather than asserting one actual hedge law.
parent_paths.comparison: Analytic/reference Greeks, finite differences, local scenario approximation and full nonlinear repricing with error-controlled optimization.
parent_paths.metric: Derivative/price parity, finite-move approximation error, scenario stability, inference cost and downstream added value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Near-expiry delta saturation; surface kink; American boundary; charm sign; large correlated price/vol shock; unlike units.
parent_paths.decision_use: Provide stable local and finite-move sensitivity information appropriate to the consumer's actual scenario.

parent_paths.starting_point: Carry yesterday's OI and subtract the next file.
parent_paths.existing_path: Published-report lineage, comparable contract intervals and revision/terminal-state labels.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Flat endpoint tables lose reporting cadence, missing-report patterns and the distinction between actual change and later revision.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Represent OI as a versioned report-event ledger with comparable interval identities, lifecycle transitions and revision innovations. Generate next-report label families and support masks from one deterministic compiler; retain current vintage, later revised value and measurement uncertainty separately, never inventing an intraday position observation.
parent_paths.comparison: Last-known table, naive-date diagnostic and event-ledger label service on identical reports.
parent_paths.metric: Report/contract reconciliation, label-maturity fidelity, revision attribution and reusable-label cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Weekend gap; omitted zero versus missing row; exercise/adjustment; late revision; new contract; changed publication schedule.
parent_paths.decision_use: Supply dependable endpoint supervision and clearly identified report innovations to all OI/holdings models.

parent_paths.starting_point: Estimate OI by adding a fraction of volume.
parent_paths.existing_path: Constrained count/distributional models and coherent contract/strike/expiry hierarchy.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Independent forecasts miss common expiry/market shocks and can perform well in aggregate while misplacing concentration across strikes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit joint nonnegative OI-change scenarios with partially pooled lifecycle/count parameters and low-rank cross-strike/expiry shocks. Compare aggregate reconciliation with jointly generated samples, preserving new/zero/expiring contract regimes and uncertainty in report revisions; evaluate concentration relocation as well as totals.
parent_paths.comparison: Persistence/volume fraction, independent count model, hierarchical reconciled forecasts and joint factor/count scenarios.
parent_paths.metric: Count/distribution proper loss, aggregate coherence, small/new-contract and node-placement error, downstream value.
parent_paths.fixtures: Same total with wrong strike allocation; many contracts share shock; expiration; sparse new listing; revision outside trade-only bound.
parent_paths.decision_use: Forecast the distribution of where aggregate positions may be reported, not just a chain-level total.

parent_paths.starting_point: Update inferred holdings deterministically from signed flow.
parent_paths.existing_path: Frozen holdings, latent opening/closing scenarios, coherent filtering and endpoint nonidentification.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single chosen filter can appear precise despite many compatible intraday paths, and downstream usefulness may not require identifying one path.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare a family of identified-compatible latent transition models with shared one-time evidence assimilation and endpoint likelihoods. Propagate model/parameter/path uncertainty separately; test decision sensitivity across plausible filters against direct observable flow-to-path challengers. Do not score an unavailable intraday truth as if observed.
parent_paths.comparison: Frozen/proportional scenarios, one state-space filter, uncertainty-preserving model family and direct predictive bypass.
parent_paths.metric: Endpoint forecast loss, synthetic path recovery where truth is known, uncertainty sensitivity, downstream net and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Different paths share endpoint; flow reused through O07; exercise shock; filter collapses after duplicate evidence; direct model works without holdings.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use latent holdings only to the extent supported by observations and added decision value, preserving uncertainty that endpoints cannot resolve.

parent_paths.starting_point: Treat a signed Gamma board as dealer positioning.
parent_paths.existing_path: Explicit holdings/sign scenarios, gross concentration, correct units and nonlinear finite-move alternatives.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Separate boards obscure how Gamma, vanna, charm and surface/price shocks interact, while arbitrary sums create meaningless strength.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Create common scenario response fields over source coordinate, tenor and shock, retaining gross concentration, assumed signed sensitivities and full repriced delta/option-value changes as distinct channels. Compare interpretable local boards with low-rank joint response summaries; empirical hedging/price response remains a separate forecast, not a measured position.
parent_paths.comparison: Static prior-OI Gamma, mechanical repricing, all Greek/holdings scenarios and joint finite-shock response representation.
parent_paths.metric: Unit/repricing fidelity, scenario stability, concentration information, incremental path/value and inference cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Call/put sign scenario reverses; delta saturates; vanna/charm interaction; missing wing; coverage loss changes total.
parent_paths.decision_use: Represent the full exposure information and uncertainty while keeping mechanical sensitivity separate from actual market behavior.

parent_paths.starting_point: Call every Gamma-board change new dealer flow.
parent_paths.existing_path: Mechanical spot/surface/time, holdings and universe changes with ordered/symmetric attribution.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Aggregate attribution hides which contracts drive a change and may allocate interactions differently under different factor orderings.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Produce contract-to-node-to-chain attribution with explicit joint interaction terms and common-universe controls. Compare exact bounded-factor Shapley/symmetric allocation with the cheaper ordered reference, reporting allocation sensitivity; model unexplained future-relevant residuals only after measured/assumed factors and data changes are exposed.
parent_paths.comparison: Raw change, ordered decomposition, symmetric/Shapley alternatives and interpretable residual features.
parent_paths.metric: Reconstruction error, factor-order stability, source/coverage attribution, incremental information and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Spot and IV move together; holdings scenario changes; contract birth/expiry; missing quote; node identity splits.
parent_paths.decision_use: Explain exposure evolution at useful spatial scales and test which residual changes add information beyond mechanical repricing.

parent_paths.starting_point: Pick the largest strike peaks or draw dots by size.
parent_paths.existing_path: All supported concentration nodes, explicit widths/uncertainties and stable split/merge identity.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single smoothing threshold creates fragile nodes, and point identity can jump between nearby peaks as weights change.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add multiscale density/prominence persistence and scenario-consensus node sets, retaining tiny supported nodes and uncertain identity. Match nodes by member overlap plus constrained transport/geometry, comparing with deterministic adjacent-strike clusters; do not equate smoothing-scale persistence with observed lifetime.
parent_paths.comparison: Individual strikes/top peaks, adjacent clusters, multiscale persistence, scenario-consensus nodes and bounded learned widths.
parent_paths.metric: Node/support stability, split/merge fidelity, density/width-matched role value, sensitivity and runtime.
parent_paths.fixtures: Equal peaks; broad plateau; tiny persistent cluster; scenario-dependent sign; missing strike; two nodes merge.
parent_paths.decision_use: Generate stable, well-supported spatial objects whose geometry and identity uncertainty can be used explicitly downstream.

parent_paths.starting_point: Assume a growing or moving node will attract price.
parent_paths.existing_path: Distinct mechanical/holdings growth, persistence, migration, thinning and conditional path roles.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Node-by-node scalar trends miss interacting clusters, uncertain lineage and the difference between temporary revaluation and persistent structural change.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit a joint node transition model with lineage, neighboring topology, factor-attributed changes and scenario uncertainty. Compare independent slopes/hazards with a sparse relational duration model forecasting survival, displacement, width/mass change and role; retain a future exposure-field challenger from which nodes are derived.
parent_paths.comparison: Persistence/static rank, independent hazards, attribution-conditioned relational transitions and field-evolution challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Joint survival/migration calibration, identity uncertainty, useful role lifetime, matched-density net and cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Node moves mechanically then returns; one splits into two; original grows only after observed delivery; missing chain mimics thinning.
parent_paths.decision_use: Forecast how useful option-derived structure evolves and how that changes future opportunities, with timing and provenance intact.

parent_paths.starting_point: Read named Gamma-chart patterns as fixed market narratives.
parent_paths.existing_path: Every named topology grammar is measurable, with continuous alternatives and no mandatory exclusions.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Narrative categories overlap and can hide the exact relative geometry or transition that carries information.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a continuous relational grammar over ordered nodes, gaps, opposing/gross concentration, slope/curvature, scenario state and temporal change. Preserve each named detector and forecast its transitions; compare sparse grammar features with graph motifs and a small temporal model, separately scoring whipsaw, rainbow, squeeze, weakening, decoy, stairstep, delivery and event-failure branches.
parent_paths.comparison: Each source pattern, continuous topology baseline, sparse relational motifs and optional temporal graph model.
parent_paths.metric: Pattern-definition fidelity, branch/path proper loss, robustness to node extraction, net contribution and complexity.
parent_paths.fixtures: Same topology fits two names; king changes sign but remains largest magnitude; distant node never reachable; midrange useful; missing wing mimics air pocket.
parent_paths.decision_use: Convert the entire pattern vocabulary into interpretable geometry and dynamics that can be improved without treating narrative names as truths.

parent_paths.starting_point: Summarize the chain with a few totals or one expiry.
parent_paths.existing_path: Per-expiry specialists, coordinate-aware sets/graphs and causal temporal encoders.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Unstructured pooling can lose strike/tenor localization, while a large graph wastes capacity on sparse or redundant contracts.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare a hierarchical low-rank strike-by-expiry representation with shared contract encoding, local coordinate interactions and temporal residuals. Retain absolute and normalized coordinates, support masks and lifecycle; benchmark information-matched engineered summaries, per-expiry fusion and structured encoders, with separate auxiliary targets and no label feedback.
parent_paths.comparison: Scalar/tabular, per-expiry fusion, existing set/graph, hierarchical tensor factors and bounded temporal residual model.
parent_paths.metric: Common-target proper loss, small-node/localization error, missing-support robustness, net contribution and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Same totals different strike allocation; expiry appears/disappears; permutation changes output; sparse wing; auxiliary OI label not mature.
parent_paths.decision_use: Capture joint spatial and temporal chain structure efficiently while proving which information and representation improve forecasts.

parent_paths.starting_point: Count large calls/puts or sum premium.
parent_paths.existing_path: Complete contracts/premium flow ledgers with side/unknown, expiry/cohort and feed-versus-aggregate distinctions.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Totals lose moneyness/expiry distribution, duration and unusual flow relative to a contract's expected activity.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add incremental strike/expiry/size flow surfaces, multi-memory signed/gross paths and exposure-normalized innovations, with exact reconciliation to the original ledger. Track breadth and concentration separately from intensity; preserve raw call/put and aggressor channels rather than compressing them into one sentiment score.
parent_paths.comparison: Raw volume/premium, signed totals, spatial/temporal flow surfaces and simple residual summaries.
parent_paths.metric: Ledger conservation, support/scale stability, incremental path/OI information and runtime.
parent_paths.fixtures: Top-N feed omits trades; same total spread across expiries; one expensive contract dominates premium; uncertain side; corrected trade.
parent_paths.decision_use: Retain where, when and how options trading occurred so downstream models can distinguish new information from routine activity.

parent_paths.starting_point: Weight signed flow by delta or Gamma.
parent_paths.existing_path: Distinct delta/Gamma/vega/vanna/charm CVD/OHLC with event-frozen, arrival-repriced and revalued paths.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Separate local Greek totals hide nonlinear response and joint shock dependence; current revaluation can obscure the original traded information.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: For each eligible trade, retain frozen local sensitivities and a common finite-shock response vector from contemporaneously available valuation/scenarios. Aggregate by time/expiry/cohort with exact units and sign uncertainty; compare local weighted CVD with full repriced scenario-flow summaries and their subsequent mechanical revaluation, never calling them actual hedge flow.
parent_paths.comparison: Contracts/premium only, every separate Greek channel, frozen/repriced alternatives and joint finite-shock flow representation.
parent_paths.metric: Sensitivity/repricing fidelity, path OHLC correctness, scenario uncertainty, each channel's incremental value and cost.
parent_paths.fixtures: Vega omitted by a delta/Gamma-only shortcut; late receipt changes valuation; near-expiry saturation; mapping Jacobian changes; unlike units.
parent_paths.decision_use: Upgrade all weighted-flow channels together while preserving their individual experiments and the timing of the original trade information.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use one magnitude-weighted mean strike and symmetric bands.
parent_paths.existing_path: Source above/below-mean centers, filter conventions, opening envelopes and robust alternatives.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A scalar center can sit between modes and change dramatically when an uncertain distant cluster appears.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Represent the normalized magnitude distribution with weighted quantiles, cluster-specific centers and asymmetric envelopes across common scenarios. Compare source mean/filter/opening-envelope variants with distributional summaries and consensus versus scenario-specific center regions; uncertainty is a scenario range unless probabilistically calibrated.
parent_paths.comparison: Exact source center, all/per-expiry, trimmed/quantile alternatives and multimodal scenario-aware distribution.
parent_paths.metric: Arithmetic/filter fidelity, center stability, multimodal support, role/path information and downstream net.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two equal peaks; zero total; 50%-of-king differs from percentile; upper/lower split uses mean not spot; opening window incomplete.
parent_paths.decision_use: Describe the full center/band information without forcing a misleading mean to stand for a multimodal board.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use put/call or volume/OI ratios and ranked activity.
parent_paths.existing_path: Distinct count, volume, premium, breadth, concentration, same-time relative flow and OI-relative features.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Composition changes and sparse denominators can look like unusual participation even when within-contract activity is normal.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Fit partially pooled expected activity by contract lifecycle, tenor/moneyness, clock exposure and supported market state. Decompose breadth expansion, within-contract intensity, signed imbalance and composition migration; compare residual feature tensors with raw ratios and simple shrinkage before nonlinear models.
parent_paths.comparison: Raw ratios/totals, shrunken relative activity, component residuals and structured interaction challenger.
parent_paths.metric: Count/flow target proper loss, sparse-denominator stability, decomposition fidelity, incremental path/net and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: New listings inflate breadth; tiny known OI; a few expensive options dominate premium; partial chain; changing expiry mix.
parent_paths.decision_use: Identify what is unusual about participation and whether its breadth, intensity or directional composition carries future information.

parent_paths.starting_point: Port equity-option indicators directly to futures options.
parent_paths.existing_path: Style/UDS-aware native flow, OI/settlement and separately eligible trade/settlement-implied valuation.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Missing continuous quotes can block a large indicator stack even though valuation-free strike/expiry flow still contains distinct information.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a native valuation-free contract/strike/expiry activity and signed-flow surface with report innovations and decoded outright/package structure. Add settlement/trade-implied sensitivity channels only on eligible cohorts, and compare their increment separately against native flow and OPRA information using matched dates.
parent_paths.comparison: Futures price, OI/settlement, native flow-only, eligible valuation channels and combined cross-chain models.
parent_paths.metric: Native ledger fidelity, unique common-target information, support robustness, net contribution and data cost.

parent_paths.decision_use: Use all supported native futures-option information without fabricating a quoted surface or losing the flow-only branch.

parent_paths.starting_point: Group nearby similar-size prints into a sweep or spread.
parent_paths.existing_path: Condition flags, causal temporal/size/leg-ratio grouping and explicit package uncertainty.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: One committed grouping can double-count trades or assign incompatible package directions with unjustified certainty.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Create a causal hypothesis graph of mutually compatible package groupings, with bounded candidate matches and one-use trade accounting per hypothesis. Aggregate flow/sensitivity under each admissible grouping and report ambiguity; compare deterministic clustering with probabilistic weights only when labelled support justifies them.
parent_paths.comparison: No grouping, condition/source-window rule, deterministic clustering and compatible-hypothesis ensemble.
parent_paths.metric: Trade-use conservation, grouping fidelity on eligible labels, sensitivity range, downstream increment and compute.
parent_paths.fixtures: Two possible parents share a print; delayed leg; repeated size by chance; later leg changes hypothesis; incomplete ratio.
parent_paths.decision_use: Preserve economically meaningful package possibilities without turning a heuristic into known order identity or intent.

parent_paths.starting_point: Gate options on one freshness or confidence flag.
parent_paths.existing_path: Common joint uncertainty propagated through valuation, exposure, nodes and path forecasts.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Large upstream uncertainty can be harmless to the chosen action, while a small uncertainty near a ranking boundary can matter greatly.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Add downstream decision-sensitivity attribution across quote, sign, surface, holdings, mapping and model scenarios. Compare source-validity masks, forecast-spread gates and action-instability/value-of-better-measurement diagnostics; keep early quality ports separate from later decision sensitivity to preserve the DAG.
parent_paths.comparison: Point estimate, joint scenarios, reliability meta-gate and decision-relevant sensitivity rules.
parent_paths.metric: Calibration, selected risk/coverage/net, disagreement attribution, uncertainty width and marginal data/compute value.
parent_paths.fixtures: All scenarios choose same action; one uncertain node reverses ranking; correlated common errors; duplicate evidence shrinks interval.
parent_paths.decision_use: Use options uncertainty according to its effect on decisions and identify which missing precision would actually be worth improving.

parent_paths.starting_point: Trade the strongest node as a universal magnet or reversal.
parent_paths.existing_path: Independent reach, role, runner, room and lifetime heads; mediated and direct predictive challengers.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Separate heads can disagree on path order and hide whether latent holdings add anything beyond observable chain/flow information.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a candidate-landmark path/role model with joint contact, departure, retrace, continuation and duration outputs under common scenarios. Compare mediated exposure features, direct observables and their residual mixture with factorial representation/information controls; integrate pre-touch arrival uncertainty without importing realized arrival features.
parent_paths.comparison: Static node rule, simple role model, direct/mediated existing heads and coherent relational path model/mixture.
parent_paths.metric: Joint role/time proper loss, calibration, mediation-versus-direct increment, lifetime and complete-policy net.
parent_paths.fixtures: Node predicts touch but not useful departure; runner after retrace; source-only opportunity; small node; latent model improves OI but harms action value.
parent_paths.decision_use: Forecast what option structure means for attainable receiver paths and determine whether each latent or direct information path earns its complexity.

parent_paths.starting_point: Use the max-pain minimizing strike as a price target.
parent_paths.existing_path: Exact compatible terminal payoff curve and full minimizer set with simple role controls.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: The minimizer discards slope, concentration and asymmetric payout geometry, and may not be stable to incomplete OI support.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Retain the full piecewise-linear payout curve, one-sided slopes, normalized excess payout, minimizer interval and strike-local slope changes across valid OI/support scenarios. Compare these deterministic curve features with the scalar minimizer, nearby round strikes and other node/profile references; predictive use remains an independent hypothesis.

parent_paths.metric: Payoff/slope parity, minimizer stability, placebo-adjusted path/role evidence and net contribution.

parent_paths.existing_path: Backward availability joins, source ages, event-triggered grids and latency uncertainty.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: Coarse snapshots lose event order, while naive event merges can overreact to frequent sources or compare unequal information delays.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Build a multi-rate causal event view with source-liveness and publication-age channels, bounded event coalescing and explicit partial order for uncertain timing. Compare common-clock and source-triggered decisions at matched observation/delay budgets; downstream lag models use admitted observations only.

parent_paths.metric: As-of/order fidelity, retained fresh information, forecast/value versus delay, event load and runtime.

parent_paths.existing_path: Causal affine/basis/parity mappings with Jacobians, domains and uncertainty.
parent_paths.remaining_gap: A single point estimate ignores carry/maturity dependence, structural changes and correlated error across mapped nodes.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Use a joint coordinate/basis state with explicit carry/expiry structure and residual bands, comparing robust filtered updates with fixed/rolling maps. Propagate common mapping scenarios through all related objects and sensitivities, test round-trip/domain behavior and compare joint observation models when both coordinates are noisy; keep predictive cross-index transmission separate.

parent_paths.decision_use: Map related instruments consistently and quantify whether mapping uncertainty matters to an actual one-mini decision.

Compare hierarchical residual fusion and sparse cross-chain interactions against simple pooled forecasts, preserving each chain, small-node and source-only cohort plus native flow-only eligibility.

Separately pass predictions into actual one-mini ES economics and P12's budget-fit comparison; report full-supported and matched-date evidence without merging their claims.

Compare distributed response kernels and event-survival models, distinguishing fast already-realized response from slower remaining effect; source-event matching and negative controls use only admissible past information.

parent_paths.remaining_gap: A large joint model can learn coverage artifacts or repeat common factors, while its useful cross-source interactions remain opaque.
parent_paths.further_upgrade: Compare a shared low-rank common-state model with sparse, directed, lagged residual interactions and uncertainty-aware source masks. Add graph/attention residuals only after this structured baseline; preserve per-source/expiry ablations, interaction tests and equal information/compute comparisons, with all current-cut ports acyclic.
parent_paths.comparison: Additive/per-chain fusion, regularized interactions, common-plus-residual hierarchy and bounded set/graph/temporal challengers.
